- **Evidence:** Affine on 24 patches: held-out 16 new patches median r 0.724 (bar >= 0.85) and RMS 1.92 vox (bar <= 1.5): FAIL. Per-patch local shift gives NCC median 0.881; rescan sits 2-3.4 vox lower in z near the centre than at the periphery. Affine + quadratic field (21 parameters, chosen by leave-one-out on old correspondences, frozen before new data): median r 0.863, RMS 0.977 vox: PASS; LOO RMS 1.044 vs 1.715 affine. Organizer's 2.4 um meshes are an affine image of the 9 um meshes (residual 0.43 vox).
- **Fix:** Fit affine + smooth quadratic field on CT phase-correlation correspondences and validate on fresh pre-registered held-out patches with a half-pitch shifted control; expect ~1-3 vox local misalignment in organizer cross-resolution products (median 1.20 vox at the fold-A tiles: negligible for 150 px letter matching, not for pixel labels).
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25..2026-09-30 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#REG-0841-R1, #REG-0841-NA; dominion:sib-reg0841:logs/sib/reg0841/REPORT.md, logs/sib/reg0841na/reg0841na_summary.json; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (REG-0841-R1); logs/sib/reg0841/reg0841_summary.json, RULES.md (REG-0841-R1); dominion:sib-reg0841@1bdfd0bae:logs/sib/reg0841/REPORT.md; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (PHerc0841 9 um <-> 2.4 um registration, single affine (REG-0841-R1))

### L061. Rescan registration: test flips and remounts first, require z-consistency, and expect affine to beat translation by far
- **Trap:** A coarse orientation search can pick a single-slice match (for example flipZ) or a 'remount rotation' that is not a physical tilt.
- **Evidence:** PHerc0841: identity median NCC 0.825 with z-IQR 0; flipZ matched single slices (0.76) but scattered dz by 3200 vox. PHerc1203 / PHerc0846A: no flip or axis permutation; the coarse remount rotation was absorbed by the fitted M; translation-only held-out RMS 2.899 / 9.422 vox vs affine 0.732 / 0.720 vox (PHerc0846A fit iteration 1, the result of record; iteration 2 gave 0.718); PHerc1203 PASSED (median r 0.879), PHerc0846A FAILED r (0.844) with RMS and control passing; per-patch optimum reached 0.878, pointing to non-affine misfit. Round trip 9 -> 2.4 -> 9 um exact to 1.82e-12 vox.
- **Fix:** Search all 8 flips/remounts with whole-volume NCC and require the implied dz to be consistent across slices; fit a full affine, check on fresh patches with a half-pitch shifted control, and pre-register any non-affine follow-up with new patches.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25..2026-09-30 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-reg0841:logs/sib/reg0841/REPORT.md; dominion:sib-regrescan:logs/sib/regrescan/REPORT.md; dominion:sib-regrescan@da0a72fbb:logs/sib/regrescan/REPORT.md; summary.json heldout_median_r 0.8789436251344623, logs/sib/regrescan/REPORT.md; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (PHerc1203 9.362 <-> 2.403 um CT affine (regrescan))

### L062. A flattening benchmark must be able to fail
- **Trap:** Comparing flattening methods on gentle patches where even the unflattened grid passes.
- **Evidence:** Primary set (5 seeded 4 cm^2 PHerc0139 rectangles): vc_flatten 98.59-99.67 %, SLIM 99.59-100 %, ARAP 99.61-100 % of quads within +-5 %, but the unflattened levelled grid already scores 97.39-99.55 %. Code-chosen hard set (10 most curved / least isometric windows of 38 bank meshes): vc_flatten 0/10, SLIM 3/10, ARAP 4/10 reach 93.1 %; ABF++ collapsed 3 times (UV rescale up to x3.36; 22.2 % within +-5 %), SLIM never flipped and scored >= vc_flatten in 33/33 cases.
- **Fix:** Include a code-selected hard set and an unflattened baseline; prefer SLIM (symmetric Dirichlet from the levelled grid) and report vc_flatten alongside.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25..2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-flat1:logs/sib/flat1/REPORT.md, logs/sib/flat1/flat1_report.json; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:logs/pp/verify_flatcheck.json; dominion:sib-pp-flatcheck@ec5d06476:tools/sib/pp-flatcheck/vc-flatcheck/README.md; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:logs/pp/SUBMIT_SHEET.md, logs/pp/submissions.jsonl; dominion:sib-flat1@b5594d021:logs/sib/flat1/REPORT.md; flat1_summary.json sha256 13366219..., logs/sib/flat1/REPORT.md; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (FLAT-1 flattening method selection); dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:CHANGELOG.md

### L063. Flattening distortion is intrinsic to curvature and grows with patch size
- **Trap:** Expecting a better flattener or a margin trim to rescue crushed regions, or a 93.1 %-within-5 % bar to hold at window scale.
- **Evidence:** Official whole-segment flattening of two Paris 4 segments: 84.30 % and 86.46 % of quads within +-5 %; 65 % and 64 % of read-eligible tiles fail the 93.1 % bar. On a ~318 cm^2 full-resolution region SLIM reached 86.49 % vs vc_flatten 78.07 %. % within +-5 % falls monotonically with mean |angle defect| for every method; the R + 2 mm margin trim never changed a verdict; LSCM-only scored 15.7-65.6 %. The 93.1 % figure is close to whole-segment ABF++ values (inference, not verified).
- **Fix:** Report per-tile distortion with each reading and do not assume a fixed bar is reachable in crushed papyrus; measure on the reading window itself.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25..2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-flat1:logs/sib/flat1/REPORT.md, logs/sib/flat1/p4_flat.json, logs/sib/flat1/p4win/metrics.json; dominion:sib-flat1@b5594d021:logs/sib/flat1/REPORT.md; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (FLAT-1 hard set (most curved windows))

### L064. The official villa tracer bridges sheets 8 vox apart; a rejection gate stops bridging but kills area
- **Trap:** Unmodified GrowPatch growth jumps between neighbouring sheets; naive gating then freezes growth or leaves holes.
- **Evidence:** Synthetic scenes: villa main bridged two sheets 8 vox apart (B: 3-5 bridge edges; with space_line 125-173 edges). Build c4 (NaN-safe distance + cost gate, 8-neighbour edge sampling, final audit, seed-component filter) never bridged (T1 pass all presets) but L presets failed full-area growth in 1-2 of 3 repeats (core coverage 0.88-0.95) and S presets died at the seed on 3-4 of 6 dev seeds; in run 1, before the audit, L20/L25 put up to 80 vertices on the other sheet.
- **Fix:** Gate every candidate (point and edges to all 8 neighbours), audit final positions, keep only the seed-connected component, and test on synthetic two-sheet, hole and clean-sheet scenes with a freeze negative control before real data.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25..2026-10-01 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-tracer:logs/sib/tracer/REPORT.md; dominion:sib-tracer@bee2fe682:logs/sib/tracer/REPORT.md; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Rejection-gated surface tracer)

### L065. Validate a cheap geometric proxy (centroid, sheet walker) against official ground truth before relying on it
- **Trap:** Planning seeds from cheap geometric proxies (CT-mask centroid, pre-trace duplicate walker) without checking them against official ground truth.
- **Evidence:** The census lane placed 654 of 660 planned seeds over 11 eligible volumes, with a tractability ranking and run sheets for the top 3. The mask centroid lay about 0.14-0.21 r_eq (median) from the official umbilicus, so seed wrap fractions are uncertain on oval scrolls. The pre-trace duplicate walker reached AUC 0.60 on |dr| and was labelled low-reliability.
- **Fix:** Validate each proxy against official ground truth before relying on it; here the centroid passed with caveats and the walker did not.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-25..2026-10-01 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-census@d941473f6:logs/sib/census/REPORT.md; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Census lane: tracing seed plan for 11 eligible volumes)

### L066. Centre sources for handedness: condition-check the normal-line centre; lasagna has no sign; centroid must not veto the umbilicus
- **Trap:** Using any available centre estimate as an equal vote.
- **Evidence:** PHerc1447 source conflicts came from an ill-conditioned normal-line centre (condition number 17-35, near-parallel normals); lasagna normals are hemisphere-canonicalised (nz >= 0) and carry no outward sign; the CT-mask centroid vetoed the official umbilicus on one PHerc0139 segment. With a cond <= 10 gate and the centroid informational when an umbilicus exists, PHerc0139 became 38/38 HIGH; PHerc0800 and 2 of 3 PHerc0841 dropped to MEDIUM (cond 13-23), state unchanged.
- **Fix:** Use the umbilicus first; accept the normal-line centre only if cond <= 10; mask out patches reversed under every source (<= 20 %) instead of letting them vote.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-handed:logs/sib/handed/REPORT.md, logs/sib/handed/h2/mixed_chirality.json

### L067. Scroll-centre estimates: CT-mask centroid errors of ~300-400 vox; normal-based centres are worse
- **Trap:** Placing seeds or judging wrap fraction from a mask centroid as if it were the umbilicus.
- **Evidence:** Against the official umbilicus (PHerc0125/0211/0826) the CT-mask centroid has median error 298-386 vox (p90 up to 1047; up to ~0.45 r_eq on oval volumes), i.e. wrap-fraction uncertainty ~+-0.2. A CT-free centre from m7 sheet normals was worse (median 396-448 vox vs 231-304 for the centroid at the same z). On PHerc0139 the centroid offset is 474 vox median but still gives the right outward half-space on all but 1-2.5 % of the cross-section.
- **Fix:** Use the official umbilicus where it exists; otherwise the centroid with an UNRELIABLE flag when axis ratio < 0.65 or solidity p10 < 0.85 (flagged: PHerc0257, 0358, 0846A, 0846B, 1545).
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-25 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-census:logs/sib/census/REPORT.md; dominion:sib-handed:logs/sib/handed/REPORT.md

### L068. Validate a duplicate (same-sheet) detector on known pairs before trusting its counts
- **Trap:** Counting seed duplicates with a geometric walker before tracing.
- **Evidence:** Walker v2 on official PHerc1203 dev-set pairs: SAME on 13 of 35 determined same-sheet positives vs 5 of 30 adjacent-sheet negatives (AUC 0.60); walker v1 3/36 vs 2/35 (AUC 0.47) and its counts were discarded. Most census seed pairs in reach were undetermined because the walker loses the sheet on long paths.
- **Fix:** Report only the hard geometric upper bound before tracing, and apply the binding duplicate test after tracing on traced meshes (point-to-triangulated-surface, CORR-RETRACE-RULE form b), dropping the later seed of each SAME pair.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-census:logs/sib/census/REPORT.md, README.md

### L069. Two trace generations of the same sheet can sit 1-5 vox apart and fail the same-papyrus rule
- **Trap:** May-2025 and September-2025 traces of the same PHerc0009B sheet are offset by a smooth cross-frame error field, so the [2,3) vox bin is too full and the rule says NOT SAME.
- **Evidence:** 5 pairs had 300k-500k near-coincident points (MAD 0.57-0.69 vox after removing a per-64-vox-cell median offset; cell medians about -4.5..+3 vox; 15-35 % of points within 2 vox) yet were NOT SAME by rule; a strict MAD <= 0.8 vox criterion merges them, giving 4 units instead of 6.
- **Fix:** Add an offset-field sensitivity check (remove smooth per-cell normal offset, then test MAD) and, for exclusions, treat such pairs as the same papyrus (fail-closed).
- **Label:** INFERENCE · **When:** 2026-09-25 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-reg0009b:logs/sib/reg0009b/REPORT.md

### L070. Registration needs depth correction: the nominal slab centre fails most segments
- **Trap:** Mapping 2.4 um reference ink maps onto a 9 um canvas with the nominal surface-volume centre slice assumes the two meshes sit at the same depth.
- **Evidence:** PHerc0009B: whole-segment NCC >= 0.80 passed on 18/18 segments only after a per-pixel depth-corrected slab; at nominal slice 54, 13 of 18 were below 0.80. The best-matching 2.4 um slice departs from nominal by -0.23..+1.49 9-um vox and is tilted; slope dk/ds9 3.51-3.61 (expected 3.60) confirms normals are not flipped; a (40, 40) px null gave about 0.00.
- **Fix:** Run a depth check (per-tile best slice vs nominal, slope sign) before any registration gate, and correct depth before reporting NCC; note the selection optimism of a depth field chosen by NCC (one segment passed by 0.002).
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-reg0009b:logs/sib/reg0009b/REPORT.md, README.md

### L071. Organizer 2.4 um meshes are an affine image of the 9 um meshes, not independent evidence
- **Trap:** Using the organizer's paired meshes to validate a cross-resolution registration only re-measures the organizer's own transform.
- **Evidence:** PHerc0841: 105,024 UV-corresponding node pairs over 3 segments fit an affine with median 0.43 and RMS 0.55 rescan vox residual; the CT-fitted affine differs from the mesh affine by RMS 3.03 vox (max 5.0) at patch centres away from the meshes. Near the meshes the mesh affine agrees with CT (<= 1.4 px).
- **Fix:** Use mesh-pair affines only as a coarse start and near the meshes; validate registration on CT patches away from them.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-25 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-reg0841:logs/sib/reg0841/REPORT.md

### L072. Sheet-crossing peak counts do not give a reliable winding number
- **Trap:** Counting intensity peaks along rays to decide how many windings lie inward of the innermost labelled winding.
- **Evidence:** 2.4 um (p4-core): 3161 valid ray samples over 25 z-levels; median 5 peaks inward (IQR 4-6), only 1.8 % of rays above 10. Calibration on the labelled zone gave a median of 12 where 10 are expected (+20 % over-count, 32 % of rays within +-1). Synthetic validation on 192 spiral cases NOT PASSED: 63 % within +-1 winding, bias -1.33 (37 % at 0.04 mm pitch, 48 % with a 0.15 mm umbilicus offset). The count changed on 61 % of adjacent-ray pairs and 82 % of adjacent-z pairs 5 mm apart.
- **Fix:** Do not open a trace or claim extra windings from a raw count. Build a z-coherent peak tracker and an umbilicus refinement, then re-validate on synthetics that reproduce the real over-count.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-26..2026-10-01 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-core:README.md, logs/sib/p4-core/STATUS.md, logs/sib/p4-core/trace_plan.md; dominion:sib-p4-core@11b9c7d20:logs/sib/p4-core/count.json; dominion:sib-p4-inner@f5fbbd23d:logs/sib/p4-inner/REPORT-P47.md; survey:expmap_raw.json:paris4-census

### L073. Model-free raw-CT channels show no column layout; validate layout statistics on known text of the same strip
- **Trap:** Looking for title/column structure in raw-CT slab means or thin-slab maxima.
- **Evidence:** 1 mm column profiles: the official 2.4 um prediction resolves column pitch on known text (periodogram SNR 64 and 102; pitch 76-78 mm, native resolution +-8 to +-16 mm on 200-420 mm spans), while the E2 slab mean and the L2 thin-slab max have no peak in 50-120 mm (dominant period 12-16 mm) and fail.
- **Fix:** Use model predictions for layout; check any layout statistic on the known-text span of the same strip first; quote pitch with its native resolution.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-26..2026-09-30 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-layout:README.md, logs/sib/p4-layout/REPORT.md, logs/sib/p4-layout/profile.json; dominion:sib-p4-layout@148c75afe:logs/sib/p4-layout/REPORT.md; survey:expmap_raw.json:paris4-census

### L074. Official meshes do not follow the recto surface at a constant offset
- **Trap:** Building a thin slab at a constant offset d* from the official mesh to catch a surface ink layer.
- **Evidence:** 2.4 um calibration on 24 known-text tiles over 109 offsets (+-129.6 um): best excess at -31.2 um with robust z 1.94 (bar 3) -> STOP; peak FWHM 57.6 um (not a 10-20 um deposit); only 4/24 tiles had their own argmax within 5 um of the pooled peak (per-tile argmaxes from -130 to +130 um). The 1.129 um calibration also stopped (excess 1.12 robust SD). The record attributes this to the recto surface wandering relative to the mesh.
- **Fix:** Detect the sheet faces per pixel (connected run above a mid threshold nearest the mesh) or use mesh-free surface detection; test any depth rule on synthetic no-layer sheets for specificity before use.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-26..2026-09-30 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#P4-L3E-CALIB-RESULT, #P4-L3-CALIB-RESULT, #DECL-P4-18; dominion:sib-p4-tiles-b@58981e078:logs/sib/p4-tiles-b/l3e/REPORT.md; survey:expmap_raw.json:paris4-census; dominion:sib-p4-depth:README.md, logs/sib/p4-depth/STATUS.md

### L075. The official Paris 4 inner mesh top edge is a z cut, not a sheet end; little papyrus exists above it
- **Trap:** Assuming the title's missing top rows are unrendered surface that a mesh extension would recover.
- **Evidence:** The sheet continues only about 2 mm above the official top edge in the measured columns; the published mask ends +3 to +5 mm; the CT volume would allow 9.1-9.6 mm. The top-edge register cell is mostly physically lost papyrus (P(title ink in the missing strip) about 0.04). Also: The edge is a flat z cut at 172.2-172.8 mm (p5-p95) in every column, equal to the spiral-fit z limit of 172.8 mm. A CT sheet index anchored on an organizer mesh (half-pitch 125 um null, bootstrap over 759 columns, level 2 at 9.6 um) supports sheet only to about +2 mm; the organizers' scroll mask is 87 % present at 174.4 mm, 48 % at 176.3, 5 % at 177.7 and 0 % from 178.1 mm (3-5 mm above the edge).
- **Fix:** Check the scroll mask and a validated sheet index before extending a mesh; most of the missing top strip is physically lost papyrus, which also lowers the prior for a title above the edge.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-26..2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-layout:README.md, logs/sib/p4-layout/REPORT.md, logs/sib/p4-layout/edge.json; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#P4-N-RESULT, #P4-24-E2-RESULT

### L076. A random vertex sample overstates a tile's minimum distance: add a fail-closed all-vertex pass
- **Trap:** Flagging labelled-adjacent tiles (< 1.2 mm from labelled segments) from a 4096-point random sample of each tile's ~1.1e5-1.7e5 mesh vertices.
- **Evidence:** The all-vertex pass changed one flag: a tile read 1.342 mm from the sample but 1.188 mm from all vertices. The largest sample-minus-all-vertex gap was 0.252 mm. The one unflagged tile below 1.30 mm (1.254 mm) was certified by dense triangle sampling (lower bound 1.24695 mm >= 1.2).
- **Fix:** Compute exact point-to-triangulated-surface distances over every vertex; for unflagged tiles within one edge-length of the threshold, add a dense check with a proven lower bound.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-excl:README.md, logs/sib/p4-excl/REPORT.md

### L077. Exact nearest-surface distance without densifying the mesh: KD-tree plus a covering bound
- **Trap:** Densifying meshes or using nearest-vertex distance as a proxy for distance to the surface.
- **Evidence:** Every point of a triangle lies within Lc = L/sqrt(3) of a vertex (max edge L 38-50 vox), so d_s >= d_v - Lc and only triangles incident to vertices within ub + Lc need exact Ericson closest-point tests. 21/21 synthetic tests (plane, V and U folds, hole rim, equilateral lattice, far point) agreed exactly with brute force; on a real mesh 200 on-surface points gave max 1.6e-11 vox.
- **Fix:** Use the covering-bound KD-tree search for exclusion margins and certify it against brute force on synthetic sheets.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-excl:logs/sib/p4-excl/REPORT.md

### L078. The smoothing kernel's interpretation decides whether a ray counter calibrates at all
- **Trap:** Declaring '20 um smoothing' without saying FWHM or sigma, and using a 1-D detector that merges close sheets.
- **Evidence:** 1.129 um count (p4-inner, 1416 of 1536 rays): FWHM 20 um failed calibration (15 even at the top threshold) while sigma 20 um calibrated to exactly 10 and gave a median of 4 crossings inward (IQR 3-5), 1.5 % of rays above 10. Planted-sheet error <= 1 winding in at most about 81 % of trials in any pitch regime; with sigma 20 um, pitches below ~100 um were under-counted by 3-7. Adjacent-ray steps >= 2 on 19 % of pairs.
- **Fix:** Fix both interpretations in code before reading data (both were) and report both; run a 2-D planted test (sheets inserted into real planes before smoothing) and a structure-tensor cross-check before trusting any count.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-inner:README.md, logs/sib/p4-inner/REPORT-P47.md

### L079. Check grid orientation against geometry before counting: column 0 of the official Paris 4 strips is the OUTER end
- **Trap:** Assuming mesh column 0 is the innermost labelled winding.
- **Evidence:** On both official inner strips the column index increases toward the core (Spearman(column, median radius) -0.898 to -0.995; Spearman(column, winding) -0.998): column 0 is the outer end. p4-inner's first count run had this bug; it was caught before any inner count was read and the run was discarded.
- **Fix:** Derive orientation from radius/winding vs column before any count, and assert it in code.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-inner:README.md, logs/sib/p4-inner/STATUS.md

### L080. Normal spacing, not radial-fit spacing, is the sheet pitch
- **Trap:** Comparing a radial-fit pitch (0.22 mm) with peak spacings measured along rays and concluding the core is compressed.
- **Evidence:** p4-core measured normal spacing between labelled windings of 0.09-0.19 mm and inner peak spacing median 0.130 mm (IQR 0.084-0.211), labelled median 0.162 mm; the innermost labelled loop is a flattened ellipse (about 3.6-5.4 x 1.1-3.2 mm). The 0.22 mm was a radial fit, which explained the apparent discrepancy.
- **Fix:** Measure pitch along the sheet normal (or same-angle rays) and state which definition a number uses.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-core:logs/sib/p4-core/STATUS.md

### L081. A block one column wide fits a short final column at least as well as a title
- **Trap:** Reading a model-map block near the end of the text as a title because of its position.
- **Evidence:** A model-map block near the end of the text measured about 60 mm wide, which equals a full text column (pitch minus intercolumn); raw-CT channels showed nothing there. The lane concluded the width profile cannot tell text from title; a declared line-structure test was INVALID, and the question was later settled from a published edition's layout (a short final column).
- **Fix:** Test competing layout hypotheses with pre-registered decision tables (width, line pitch, letter height, indent) and use published editions' layout where available before spending reads.
- **Label:** INFERENCE · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-layout:logs/sib/p4-layout/REPORT.md; dominion:sib-p4-tiles-a:README.md

### L082. A tracker must beat a shuffled null on known sheet before its continuation distances mean anything
- **Trap:** Using a patch-correlation tracker's continuation distance without validating it.
- **Evidence:** The first edge tracker's positive-control r (p50 0.41) fell below its shuffled null (p50 0.72) and its drift was p50 148 um, p90 481 um; it was discarded and replaced by a centred-peak index anchored on an organizer mesh.
- **Fix:** Validate any tracker on known sheet against a shuffled/half-pitch null and measure drift before using its output.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-layout:README.md, logs/sib/p4-layout/edge/edge_cont.json

### L083. Validate a frame transform with a residual and a wrong-direction control before mapping meshes between scans
- **Trap:** Mapping segments between scan frames through a published transform without checking direction or accuracy.
- **Evidence:** Mapping a 7.91 um segment mesh through the inverse of the bucket transform.json onto its 2.4 um re-mesh left residuals 8.6 / 19.1 / 26.8 / 32.1 um (p10/p50/p90/p99); the wrong-direction control gave 131.8 mm. With a half winding pitch of ~125 um, mapped segments can be assigned to a winding. Some 2024 segments' volumes have no published transform at all.
- **Fix:** Always test the transform on a segment that exists in both frames, report residual percentiles against the half-pitch, and include a wrong-direction control.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-layout:logs/sib/p4-layout/REPORT.md, logs/sib/p4-layout/orgmap.json

### L084. Measure the reference chain's own shift before gating pairs at 1 px
- **Trap:** Pair gates that require 9 sub-windows to align within 1 px assume the 9 um organizer surface volume and the 2.4 um reference agree to well under a pixel.
- **Evidence:** PHerc0139 frame diagnostics on 40 tiles: our 9.362 um render vs organizer surface volume NCC 0.996 (shift 0.03 px) and our 2.399 um render vs organizer NCC 1.000, but the organizer 9.362 um surface volume vs the 2.399 um reference through the mesh affine had a median shift of 1.55 px (dy -1.20) while the mesh affine's 3-D check gives 0.09-0.18 vox. The first segment kept 652 of 2534 candidates.
- **Fix:** Before choosing a 1 px alignment bar, measure the median systematic shift between the two reference products and either correct it or set the tolerance above it; record per-patch shifts so a corrected variant is possible.
- **Label:** INFERENCE · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-pairs0139:logs/sib/pairs0139/ASK.md, logs/sib/pairs0139/gate_spec.json

### L085. More tracer generations add area that later crosses itself
- **Trap:** Growing longer to meet an area bar produces surfaces that wrap into neighbouring windings where they touch in the prediction.
- **Evidence:** PHerc1203 dev runs (L15): median v2 area 0.46 cm^2 against a planned T0 bar of 3.0 cm^2. 75-generation self-test: raw 3.34 cm^2 with 511 transverse crossings, truncated at generation 46 to 1.60 cm^2; the same seed at 45 generations gave 1.51 cm^2 with 0 crossings. Crossings were shallow (about 4 deg, about 4 vox) between grid parts 7-40 cells apart from generation 17 on.
- **Fix:** Truncate at the first crossing (v2 rule), report truncated area, and expect area bars around 3 cm^2 to fail for gated tracing on 9 um predictions.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-tracer:logs/sib/tracer/REPORT.md, logs/sib/tracer/dev/summary.json

### L086. Paris 4 official meshes start at w010; inner windings w000-w009 are unsegmented
- **Trap:** Trusting the published winding numbering to include every inner turn.
- **Evidence:** Recorded from recon: official meshes start at w010 (w000-w009 unsegmented); a count of windings inward of w010 was declared with planted-sheet tests (error <= 1 winding).
- **Fix:** Count sheet crossings from the umbilicus along >= 64 rays per z at >= 20 z-levels and validate against labelled spacing before tracing the core.
- **Label:** INFERENCE · **When:** 2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#DECL-P4-7

### L087. Audit official meshes for holes, off-sheet vertices and switches before blaming the render
- **Trap:** Assuming an official mesh is uniformly sound because it shows no winding jumps.
- **Evidence:** Mesh audit of 189 tiles: 0 winding jumps and normal flips <= 0.0003, but self-intersections in 13/99 target tiles vs 5/81 reference tiles, concentrated in one patch, and close approaches with 6.4-6.6 % of vertices below 0.3 of the spacing (reference max 2.9 %). Holes check: 0 interior holes in 180 tiles; flattening-ratio and off-papyrus flags (37.5 % and 22.5 %) on a few tiles.
- **Fix:** Run the four checks (invalid vertices/holes, zero-input fraction, 2-D/3-D area ratio > 2 or < 0.5, +-60 um normal-profile peak) against a reference range, with dense sampling before any re-trace decision.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#P4-W1-RESULT, #DECL-P4-24, #P4-24-HOLES-RESULT, #P4-24-RETRACE-RESULT; dominion:sib-p4-core:logs/sib/p4-core/STATUS.md; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md#P4-W1-RESULT; survey:expmap_raw.json:paris4-census

### L088. Straight extrapolation beyond a mesh edge stops meaning 'same sheet' after about 1 mm
- **Trap:** Flagging that papyrus continues past a mesh edge because a peak sits within +-60 um of a straight edge-tangent extrapolation.
- **Evidence:** Tested into the known mesh, the extrapolation missed the true sheet by median 3-5 um at 0.5 mm, 50-69 um at 1 mm, 137-250 um at 2 mm (24 % / 11 % of rays within +-60 um) and 343-887 um at 5 mm, while sheets are about 165 um apart. Both edge-following variants (v1 2.3 %, v2 12 % of columns) failed the >= 80 % validation bar.
- **Fix:** Use a sheet-following test (0.1 mm steps, re-centre on the profile peak) and validate it by following into the known mesh (<= 30 um mean offset at 2 mm on >= 80 % of columns) before applying it beyond the edge.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-core:logs/sib/p4-core/ASK.md, logs/sib/p4-core/STATUS.md; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#DECL-P4-24-A1, #P4-24-HOLES-RESULT, #P4-24-E2-RESULT; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md#P4-24-E2-RESULT; survey:expmap_raw.json:paris4-census

### L089. Validate an edge-continuation detector on known mesh before trusting it on unknown edges
- **Trap:** Trusting an edge-continuation detector (does the sheet continue past the mesh edge?) that was never validated on known mesh.
- **Evidence:** DECL-P4-24 audit of the official Paris 4 mesh: 0 interior holes in the whole grid; two tiles partly off the papyrus (37.5 % and 22.5 % of sampled vertices with no sheet peak). The straight edge-extrapolation test fired equally on the reference tiles (non-specific). The sheet-following edge test failed its own validation (2.3 % and 12 % of columns) and was not applied. A gated re-trace of the worst tile was rejected (1 self-intersection, fill 2.3 %). Verdict: null.
- **Fix:** Validate an edge-continuation detector on known mesh edges before running it on unknown edges.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (P4-24-HOLES-RESULT), RULES.md (P4-24-E2-RESULT), RULES.md (P4-24-RETRACE-RESULT); survey:expmap_raw.json:geometry; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md#P4-24-HOLES-RESULT; survey:expmap_raw.json:paris4-census

### L090. Local re-traces in compressed zones fail, and 'better' metrics can come from unfilled holes
- **Trap:** Re-tracing defective regions of an official mesh with a better tracer assumes the surface prediction holds the sheet there.
- **Evidence:** Paris 4 local re-traces: one crushed patch gave 1720 self-intersection pairs vs 1148 on the official mesh (gate requires 0), NOT ADOPTED; its neighbour-winding and flattening 'passes' came from 69 % of hole vertices being left unfilled. A second tile: 1 pair and only 2.3 % of the hole filled; only 39 % of official vertices there lie within 1.5 L2 vox of the m7 L2 prediction (92 % in a good window); 1212 of 2714 candidates rejected by distance.
- **Fix:** Measure how much of the target mesh lies on the prediction before attempting a re-trace; in compressed zones the bottleneck is the input prediction (for example a 2.4 um recto prediction), not tracer gates. Never count metrics computed over unfilled holes as passes.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#P4-22-RESULT, #P4-24-RETRACE-RESULT; dominion:sib-tracer:logs/sib/tracer/p4-22/REPORT.md, logs/sib/tracer/p4-24/REPORT.md, README.md; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md#P4-22-RESULT; survey:expmap_raw.json:paris4-census

### L091. A 'first peak beyond own + 30 um' facing-surface rule lands on the sheet's own second fibre layer
- **Trap:** Finding the neighbour (facing) sheet per vertex as the first intensity peak beyond the own peak plus 30 um.
- **Evidence:** Naive rule: 0/90 tiles pass the gate, with 137-27,448 self-intersections per tile; the gap had median 77 um (IQR 50-125) against a sheet spacing of about 165 um, so neighbouring vertices alternate between the own second fibre layer and the neighbour. Regularised rule: 0/36 control tiles pass (53-65 % found), rejected. Fallback (official adjacent inner-winding surface): 18/36 controls pass; median gap 137-157 um.
- **Fix:** Use the official mesh's own adjacent winding as the facing surface, or better, run the ink model in reverse layer order on the existing official canvas (verso mode) instead of building new facing meshes; require 0 self-intersections on the grid actually sampled.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-core:README.md, logs/sib/p4-core/ASK.md, logs/sib/p4-core/STATUS.md; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#DECL-P4-26-A1, #P4-26-FACING-GEOMETRY-RESULT, #DECL-P4-26-A2

### L092. Reject a re-trace that fills little of the off-sheet area while adding self-intersections
- **Trap:** Adopting a re-trace because it exists (re-trace of a partly off-sheet Paris 4 tile).
- **Evidence:** Dense profiling put 22.3 % of the tile's vertices off the sheet. The gated re-trace filled only 2.3 % of the hole area, had 1 self-intersection (the gate requires 0) and a worse seam, so it was not adopted. Verdict: failed.
- **Fix:** Reject a re-trace that fills only a tiny share of the off-sheet area while adding self-intersections, and carry the off-sheet caveat on any null from that tile.
- **Label:** INFERENCE · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md#P4-24-RETRACE-RESULT; survey:expmap_raw.json:paris4-census

### L093. Per-tile median radius gives the wrong outward direction on strips that span only about two windings
- **Trap:** Using Spearman(column, per-tile median radius) to decide which end of a strip is outward.
- **Evidence:** On strips of about 2 windings the declared rule gave weak positive values (+0.09 to +0.14; +0.127 on the first) because the scroll's out-of-roundness dominates. A same-angle crossing check gave the opposite, consistent answer: radius increases with column in only 1.8-6.9 % of pairs (93 % of 2731 pairs decreasing on the first strip), so column 0 is the outer end.
- **Fix:** Compare radii at equal polar angle (same-angle crossings) rather than per-tile medians; have the orchestrator rule before candidates are formed.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-inner:logs/sib/p4-inner/STATUS.md

### L094. Cross-strip position is uncertain by about 1 cm near strip seams
- **Trap:** Treating an arc-length locator stitched across consecutive strips as exact everywhere.
- **Evidence:** Seam gaps between consecutive strips had median 0.69-0.80 mm but p90 8-15 mm, because strip ends are ragged row to row; median strip lengths were about 31.8-32.7 cm.
- **Fix:** Carry a +-1 cm uncertainty for cross-strip positions near seams.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-inner:logs/sib/p4-inner/STATUS.md

### L095. Measure the mesh normal's sign convention instead of assuming it
- **Trap:** Assuming which side of the official mesh is recto (toward the umbilicus) from the parametrisation.
- **Evidence:** p4-depth measured that surface-volume slice index grows along -(du x dv) (360/360 vertices; profile r 0.989 vs -0.125) and that du x dv points outward (99.1 % of clear vertices), so positive offsets are inward = recto and the best (non-significant) excess at -31.2 um lies on the verso side.
- **Fix:** Measure the sign once per volume/mesh pair with a geometric-centre test and record it with the channel.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-p4-depth:logs/sib/p4-depth/STATUS.md

### L096. Predict mirror state from geometry, and do not trust a zero-CT frame gate on fragments
- **Trap:** Renders of a mesh can read mirrored; a frame check that requires < 5 % zero CT along the mesh rejects fragments whose surroundings are air.
- **Evidence:** handcheck: planted glyphs read correctly 32/32 and the wrong-sign control came out mirrored 32/32; PHerc0139 38/38 meshes HIGH unmirrored (winding check 36/36), PHerc0800 6/6; PHerc1447 11 of 15 flagged (10 FRAME_UNVERIFIED, 1 FLAG); PHerc0009B 11/18 fail the 5 % zero-CT gate (5.1-12.1 %) yet all 18 read unmirrored without the gate.
- **Fix:** Use a geometry-based mirror predictor with independent centre sources and a CT frame check, flag undecidable meshes instead of guessing, and treat frame-gate failures on fragments as a gate limitation.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-27 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-pp-handcheck:logs/sib/pp-handcheck/STATUS.md, logs/sib/pp-handcheck/PUBLISHED.json

### L097. Test sheet-following with an off-sheet control and CT-mask occupancy before rendering
- **Trap:** Rendering and reading meshes that are mostly in air or crossing sheets.
- **Evidence:** PHerc0306B: only 0.227 of segment vertices lie on the surface prediction (>= 128), and support at normal offset 0 (0.167) is no higher than at 16 vox (0.233) - a sheet-following mesh peaks at 0. PHerc0846B: median on-sheet fraction 0.1955 (0.127-0.33); only 0.215-0.677 of vertices inside the scroll CT mask (median 0.413); bounding boxes spanned 4.7-5.6 cm, i.e. tracer runaways across the scroll.
- **Fix:** Sample a few hundred vertices per mesh; require a support peak at offset 0 against offsets of +-4..16 vox and a high in-CT-mask fraction; cut tiles where the mesh is on papyrus, not merely where it is valid.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-30..2026-10-02 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-fl-pherc0306b:logs/sib/fl-pherc0306b/fl2/SURFACE_CHECK.json; dominion:sib-fl-pherc0846b:logs/sib/fl-pherc0846b/fl2/GEOMETRY_CHECK.json; dominion:sib-fl-pherc0306b@aaa3554ee:logs/sib/fl-pherc0306b/fl2/SURFACE_CHECK.json; dominion:sib-fl-pherc0846b@ebee0c09b:logs/sib/fl-pherc0846b/fl2/GEOMETRY_CHECK.json; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (DECL-FL-4-A5), RULES.md (DECL-FL-5 item 1)

### L098. Organizer segments are not automatically clean; filter snapshots and check self-crossings
- **Trap:** Tiling organizer raw segments directly.
- **Evidence:** PHerc1203 organizer raw tifxyz: 22 dirs, 17 pass checks after excluding 5 T0 tracer test ids (and, in the census selection, 116 version snapshots); the 3 largest (16.10, 12.53, 11.79 cm^2) are all NOT clean by vc_tifxyz_selfcross (transverse contacts up to 15927/19911 on two triangulations).
- **Fix:** Drop version snapshots and test ids, run vc_tifxyz_selfcross, and check every candidate tile against the crossing sites, since a tile over a crossing may mix sheets.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-30 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-fl-pherc1203:logs/sib/fl-pherc1203/NOTES.md; dominion:sib-census:logs/sib/census/fl2/organizer_selection.json

### L099. Tracer presets validated at 9 um do not hold the sheet at 17 um
- **Trap:** Growing on a coarser prediction level to save disk keeps the same preset.
- **Evidence:** FL-1 PHerc0175A at m7 level 1 (17.28 um): 4 seeds ran 80 generations, about 40 % of candidates failed the distance gate, final areas 0.0-0.30 cm^2, none reached 16 cm^2, 0 tiles. Level 0 would have needed 10-20 GB of normal-grid band (8.8 GB free).
- **Fix:** Grow at the resolution the preset was validated on (9.36-9.6 um), measure sheet pitch and prediction sharpness at the chosen level first, and provision disk for the normal-grid band.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-09-30 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-tracer:logs/sib/fl-pherc0175a/REPORT.md

### L100. Grows without normal grids are data-independent; know the failure signatures
- **Trap:** Accepting VC3D auto-grown segments because they pass an area (>= 16 cm^2) plus zero-self-intersection gate.
- **Evidence:** FL-2 template grows had no normal_grid_path: the grow log says 'empty space tracing', growth runs at ~44 mm^2/s vs 0.04-0.8 mm^2/s with organizer normal grids, and every patch reaches the geometric maximum area (26.51 cm^2 for a 150-generation step-20 patch at 8.64 um; 15 of 20 PHerc0846B grows stopped at the 31.13 cm^2 generation cap; every FL-4 grow reached the same ~11.665 cm^2 square). All had 0 self-intersections. On PHerc0191 the normal grids could not be loaded from S3 and grows ran without them. DECL-FL-4-A5/-A6 and DECL-FL-5 later found every FL-1/FL-2/FL-4 auto-grow cut across windings, voiding that material. Also: FL-2 grows ended in about 1 min at identical sizes across seeds (e.g. 297x297 grids of 26.52 cm2; 31.13 cm2 repeatedly) and FL-4 grows were all 11.665-11.674 cm2; the template's generation cap set the patch size. DECL-FL-4-A5 later showed every FL-4 surface cut across windings (median |cos| of normal vs radial 0.14-0.40 vs 1.00 for a synthetic wrap) because the grower ran without normal_grid_path; with normal grids a test grow reached median 0.93 (DECL-FL-4-A6). DECL-FL-5 found all 2,596 FL-2/FL-3 unread-scroll tiles came from the same cross-winding grower.
- **Fix:** Gate every grown surface on sheet-following (e.g. median |cos| >= 0.8, frac>0.8 >= 0.7, radius spread < 2 mm per cm) and a known-ink positive control on the same scan family before rendering; treat identical areas across seeds as a red flag.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-01..2026-10-03 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-fl-pherc0306b:logs/sib/fl-pherc0306b/fl2/SURFACE_CHECK.json; dominion:sib-fl-pherc0846b:logs/sib/fl-pherc0846b/fl2/GEOMETRY_CHECK.json; dominion:sib-fl-pilot:README.md; dominion:sib-fl-pherc0191:README.md; dominion:sib-p4v-04:README.md; dominion:sib-p4v-09:README.md; dominion:sib-p4v-06:logs/sib/p4v-06/fl2/STATUS.md; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md (DECL-FL-4-A5, DECL-FL-4-A6, DECL-FL-5), RULES.md#DECL-FL-4-A5, #DECL-FL-4-A6, #DECL-FL-4-A2; xsec:HEAD:README.md; orgsec-ink:HEAD:README.md; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (DECL-FL-4-A5); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (GP inner-winding census on PHerc0268 (FL-4 waves 41-50)); dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#DECL-FL-5

### L101. Numeric surface gates are blind to layer jumps on crushed scrolls; look at cross-sections
- **Trap:** A grown surface passes radial-normal and on-papyrus metrics while jumping between windings, and every ink map on it is a collage.
- **Evidence:** xsec: synthetic on-sheet and half-jumped patches both score median |cos| > 0.95 on the radial gate; real PHerc0268 (8.64 um) 2 x 2 cm patch grown with organizer normal grids scored median |cos| 0.928 (75 % > 0.8) and passed every numeric bar, yet raw-CT cross-sections show it holding a layer between cracks and jumping at each crack. 'Fraction on predicted papyrus' gave 0.676 (good), 0.676 (jumped), 0.628 (cutting across windings). A full day of compute was lost before looking. Also: FL-4 ring1 (DECL-FL-4-A7): a radial sheet gate (median |cos| >= 0.8, frac>0.8 >= 0.7, spread < 2 mm/cm) passed a patch at median |cos| 0.8827, yet DECL-FL-4-A8 found the grows stay on one layer between cracks and jump layers at cracks; the GP model marked 46-59 % of each patch as ink, so the ring1 maps are void.
- **Fix:** Draw every grown surface on raw CT slices at several heights (xsec) before rendering or inference; no single number replaces the picture on crushed scrolls.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-02..2026-10-10 · **Sources:** xsec:HEAD:README.md; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#DECL-FL-4-A7-E2, #DECL-FL-4-A8, #DECL-FL-5; dominion:fl4t:README.md, logs/fl4t/ring1/i102/sheet_gate.json, logs/fl4t/ring1/i101/sheet_gate.json; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:logs/pp/verify_xsec.json, logs/pp/SUBMIT_SHEET_OCT2026.md; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (xsec: cross-section check of grown surfaces); dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (DECL-FL-4-A6); dominion:fl4t@a250ae8c2:logs/fl4t/ring1/i97/sheet_gate.json; logs/fl4t/ring1/i100/sheet_gate.json; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (DECL-FL-4-A7-E2), RULES.md (DECL-FL-4-A8)

### L102. Run the phantom precondition before reading real output
- **Trap:** Reading real output from a geometry operator that has not passed a phantom with known geometry (native-resolution umbilicus DECL-UMB-2, U-turn operator, PHerc0268).
- **Evidence:** B6 flattened-roll phantom suite: 0 of 48 sections pass; core height errors of 3-4 mm in half the cases; the innermost apex was never resolved. On real data the left and right edge columns disagreed by 14-43 mm at all 3 sampled positions (B1 agreement <= 2 pitches: 0/3), and B5 coverage was 0 (no core delivered on the sampled range). Verdict: failed.
- **Fix:** Run the phantom precondition before reading real output. The phantom showed the operator cannot find the innermost turn even when the geometry is known.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-02..2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:fl4t@a250ae8c2:logs/umb/phantom_native/summary.json; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (E2E-1-RESULT, S1); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Native-resolution umbilicus DECL-UMB-2 (U-turn operator))

### L103. Phantoms must match the measured geometry, especially lamina spacing
- **Trap:** Validating a tracker on a phantom whose target is easier than the scroll.
- **Evidence:** The seed-0 phantom's target had 34-40 vox spacings against the band's 11-17; seeds were then chosen by rule (seed 2: 14-vox sheet at 14.5/15.8; seed 14: 5.3-vox ply at 12.9/12.2). Independent per-lamina tilts would make laminae cross, so tilts were correlated (common + 0.2 x own) with >= 8 vox separation. The flattened and concentric-arc phantoms were not valid for this geometry.
- **Fix:** Generate phantoms whose spacing, tilt, gap and defect statistics match a native census; hash the generator before the pilot reads real data; phantom passes are code-path evidence only.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-09..2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#ORD3-PILOTA-RESULT, #DECL-E2E-2-A2, #DECL-E2E-2-A3; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (UMB-PHANTOM-RESULT); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Umbilicus pipeline DECL-UMB-1: phantoms)

### L104. Never make sheet-level claims below the scan's native resolution
- **Trap:** Interpreting sheet continuity from a coarse pyramid level.
- **Evidence:** At 69.12 um (OME level 3) a sheet is 1.5-3 voxels and gaps are unresolved; a 'packets folded back and forth' reading was withdrawn after level-3 edge zooms showed nested concentric U-turns (the roll signature) and the owner's correction: 'the um needs to always match the um of the scan, and it's rolled not folded'.
- **Fix:** Make every claim about sheet continuity, identity, position or the innermost winding at native voxel size (8.64 um, OME level 0); coarser levels only locate windows and budget bytes.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-09 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#UMB-PHERC0268-RESULT-A1, #DECL-UNR-1-A1; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (UMB-PHERC0268-RESULT), logs/umb/PHerc0268/validation.json; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Umbilicus of PHerc0268 at survey resolution (UMB-PHERC0268-RESULT))

### L105. Measure every instance before generalising geometry
- **Trap:** Generalising geometry from one example: it was written that 'every strip is 2.25 mm, one letter tall'.
- **Evidence:** Of the 56 mass-run strips, 40 are 240/260 px renders (about 1.8 mm valid height) and 16 are 380/400 px renders (about 2.9 mm). The control letter boxes are 1.985-4.882 mm tall (median 2.887 mm; 9 of 18 taller than 2.9 mm) and their ink cores about 1.1-1.8 mm. Strip heights from results/margin_artifact/natural_experiment_PHerc0268.json (row_profile_mean_alpha, n_strips per height); box heights from the third-party public letter-box file (sha256 in docs/inputs.sha256); ink cores from a private measurement (SUPERSEDED_CLAIMS S6, S7).
- **Fix:** Measure every instance (strip heights, letter boxes) before generalising.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-09..2026-10-14 (approx.) · **Sources:** dominion:main:docs/LESSONS.md#9, results/margin_artifact/natural_experiment_PHerc0268.json, docs/SUPERSEDED_CLAIMS.md#S6

### L106. High forward/backward agreement (0.96) measures self-consistency, not sheet identity
- **Trap:** Reading a tracker's high forward/backward agreement (0.96) as evidence that it follows one sheet (DECL-UNR-1: X0 survey and X1 v0 tracker self-test, PHerc0268).
- **Evidence:** Native measurements replaced the assumed sheet geometry: sheet width median 122 um and vertical pitch median 380 um (edge window). Sanity bars on spacing and coverage showed the operator worked at the wrong scale. The level-2 census stopped at 8 of 20 planned rows (OOM, not resumed). Verdict: failed.
- **Fix:** Treat forward/backward agreement as self-consistency only; add sanity bars on spacing and coverage measured natively.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-09 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (UNR-X0-SURVEY-RESULT), RULES.md (UNR-X1-V0-RESULT); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Unrolling design DECL-UNR-1: X0 survey and X1 v0 tracker self-test)

### L107. Point-concurrency umbilicus fits fail on flattened stacks; a crushed scroll may have no single axis
- **Trap:** Fitting one axis line by concurrency of layer normals.
- **Evidence:** Circular phantoms passed (clean max error 0.072-0.087 mm), but on a flattened phantom the concurrency estimators gave median 1.34 mm, max 7.9 mm; a topological director-index estimator gave median 0.437 mm (p90 1.03). On PHerc0268, 86 sections had a field but a stable core was found in 1 (bar: coverage >= 0.5); loops of 24-32 mm enclosed director index 0.
- **Fix:** Do not promise a single axis for crushed rolls; use the stacking-direction field plus per-section defect maps; derive winding numbers only by explicit layer counting from an identified innermost layer.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-09 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#UMB-PHANTOM-RESULT, #UMB-PHERC0268-RESULT

### L108. Per-section tracing loses sheet identity within about 1 mm along the axis
- **Trap:** Building a surface by tracing each section independently or tracking at a 32-section step.
- **Evidence:** Independent per-section traces coincided with the seed only within ~1 mm and diverged onto adjacent plies (5.8 -> 42 -> 97 vox). Ridge tracking at dy 32: tracked fraction 0.56/0.63 at +-0.28 mm, 0.02/0.18 at +-1.1 mm, lost at +1.4 mm. Median motion 9-10 vox per 32 sections against competitor p10 11 vox. Identifiability budget (fraction of cells where motion + prediction error + search range < 0.5 x competitor distance) at the p90 tilt: dy 32 0.000, dy 16 0.122, dy 8 0.380, dy 4 0.841.
- **Fix:** Track on raw sections at dy <= 4 with a per-cell identifiability rule; never carry identity across a cached coarse step.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#DECL-E2E-1-A3, #E2E-1-RESULT, #ORD3-PILOTA-RESULT; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:logs/unr/e2e/ (E2E-1 band run) checks.json, RULES.md (E2E-1-RESULT); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (End-to-end band pipeline E2E-1 (trace, mesh, render, ink))

### L109. Reviving lost tracks buys coverage at the price of identity
- **Trap:** Re-anchoring dormant cells from interpolated predictions in dense stacks.
- **Evidence:** Without revival the track was accurate where it anchored (RMS 0.4-1.7 vox, zero wrong-lamina cells outside hop windows) but covered 0.32; with revival coverage rose to 0.45 while RMS rose to 24.4 vox and wrong-lamina cells from 2776 to 9502; revived cells reached RMS 13-67 vox at the block ends.
- **Fix:** Export only CLEAN cells (never dormant in the sweep) as identity-verified; keep revived cells as a separate, never-rendered layer.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#ORD3-PILOTA3-RESULT, #DECL-E2E-2-A5; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (ORD3-PILOTA-RESULT), RULES.md (ORD3-PILOTA3-RESULT); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (ORD-3 ordered-stack tracker: phantom pilot A (three runs))

### L110. A selection statistic must fail where tracking is known to fail
- **Trap:** Using a one-step acceptance margin to choose 'observable' regions.
- **Evidence:** The declared survey rule (margins >= 0.30 over between-laminae and random positions) passed all 216 windows, including the band where tracking had failed within 0.3 mm (margins 0.45/0.52 there).
- **Fix:** Validate any observability or selection statistic against a known-failure case before using it to steer work.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:logs/unr/obs/summary.json, RULES.md (OBS-SURVEY-RESULT); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Band-observability survey of PHerc0268 (OBS-SURVEY)); dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#OBS-SURVEY-RESULT

### L111. Per-row 2-D ridge acceptance cannot tell a sheet from its neighbours 8-14 voxels away
- **Trap:** Accepting a tracker's own per-row 2-D ridge acceptance as proof that it is still on the same sheet (ORD-3 pilot B on the raw native PHerc0268 block).
- **Evidence:** On real sections the tracker lost sheet identity within about 0.3 mm. CLEAN anchored fraction of seed cells: minimum 0.275 within +-0.28 mm (bar 0.80). Acceptance margin over between-laminae and random controls decayed from about 0.45 to under 0.1 (sweep medians T-C1 0.077, T-C3 0.128; bar 0.30). 70 % of injected hops went undetected (detection 0.30, flagged-only 0.0, control false alarm 0.05). The fibre-texture test had no power. Verdict: failed.
- **Fix:** Per-row 2-D ridge acceptance cannot tell a sheet from its neighbours 8-14 voxels away. Detect identity loss with declared nulls (injected hops, between-laminae controls), not with the operator's own acceptance.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:RULES.md (ORD3-PILOTB-RESULT); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (ORD-3 on the raw native block (pilot B))

### L112. Hessian ridge tracers lock onto crack rims; the m7 surface prediction is speckle in cross-sections
- **Trap:** Tracing sheets along the strongest Hessian ridge, or using the organizer surface prediction as the ridge prior.
- **Evidence:** In an xz section the m7 prediction (th 0.2) at level 0 set 24.7 % of voxels with no continuous lamina; a trace seeded on it closed on an 8 mm whorl after 26 mm. The CT Hessian bright-ridge tracer circled a crack rim for 343 mm inside a 3.6 x 8 mm box; with a symmetric-flank gate, runs ended every 5 mm; an orientation-field streamline with ridge re-anchoring reached 18.8 mm (anchored 60 %), stopping at voids (185), low coherence (115) and loops (70).
- **Fix:** Gate ridges with dark flanks on both sides; follow the structure-tensor orientation field and re-anchor; record stop reasons; choose seeds by spatial extent.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#DECL-E2E-1-A1, #DECL-E2E-1-A2

### L113. Parameters tuned on edge windows fail in the crushed interior
- **Trap:** Copying a flank distance or peak detector from the scroll's edge, where laminae are 44 vox apart, into the interior (8-16 vox).
- **Evidence:** A fixed flank distance d = 22 vox landed on neighbouring laminae: a synthetic 14-vox lamina with neighbours at 11 and 14 vox went from ungated R/tau 0.48 to gated 0.0; on the real seed row acceptance was 0.556-0.579 (d = 22) vs 0.682-0.761 with a gap-adaptive gate. The W3 peak detector found a median of 1 peak per 81-vox profile in the interior.
- **Fix:** Use gap-adaptive gates (minimum over d in {4, 6, ..., 22} along both normals, g_min 0.08) and validate every detector in the regime where it will be used.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#DECL-E2E-2-A1, #ORD3-PILOTB-RESULT, #VC3D-AUDIT-RESULT

### L114. Two-ply sheets break single-scale ridge margins
- **Trap:** A margin rule (best vs second maximum) on a sigma-4 Hessian ridge.
- **Evidence:** A 14-vox two-ply sheet gives a flat sigma-4 plateau (Rs/tau 0.55-0.68 over +-4 vox) with two maxima, so the margin rule marked 63-97 % of such cells AMBIGUOUS. Two-scale ridges (sigma 2.5 and 4) raised thin-ply acceptance 0.27 -> 0.61 and 0.66 -> 0.80 without raising between-laminae acceptance (0.04-0.05, 0.22-0.23); sigma 6 merged touching sheets (0.26-0.35).
- **Fix:** Use sigma^2-normalised maxima over {2.5, 4}; drop margin rules when the label range already excludes competitors.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#ORD3-PILOTA2-RESULT, #DECL-E2E-2-A4

### L115. Local sheet-identity tracking at 8.64 um fails across the whole of PHerc0268
- **Trap:** Hoping a better 2-D or 3-D local ridge operator, or a cleaner band, will carry identity.
- **Evidence:** On a raw 1.38 GB native block: CLEAN anchored fraction 0.633 at +-4 sections, 0.30 at 0.24 mm, 0.06 at 0.73 mm; margin over random positions fell from 0.30 to ~0.08 by 0.7 mm; tangent-texture power >= 0.8 on 0 % of rows (0.17-0.52); 70 % of injected one-spacing hops undetected (control false alarm 0.05). A 3-D Hessian operator was no better (margins 0.06-0.08). A 216-window survey found the same spacing (8-16 vox), motion (~1 vox per 4 sections) and texture power (0.33-0.56) everywhere: the band was typical.
- **Fix:** Close the local-operator line; the next lever is global (assign ridge fragments of a block to ordered sheets under non-crossing constraints across u and y).
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#ORD3-PILOTB-RESULT, #ORD3-S3-RESULT, #OBS-SURVEY-RESULT

### L116. Even about the right axis, PHerc0268 sheets are tilted ~42-48 deg RMS: the extruded-spiral model is violated
- **Trap:** Assuming the roll is a clean extruded spiral (sheets containing z) and trusting interior winding counts.
- **Evidence:** E[n_z^2] 0.45-0.55 even near the rim (RMS tilt ~42-48 deg); the roll is axially telescoped into nested cones/chevrons; the m7 interior is blob-like rather than line-like (U4 z=7250 crop, B14, B01).
- **Fix:** Judge outer windings first; record snap fraction and median offset by radius per band; compare interior windings with CT sections; treat interior turn counts as unverified.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/SPIRAL_STUDY.md, docs/units/U4-sdt.md

### L117. PHerc0268 umbilicus is a curvature-centre estimate good to only 2-7 mm at mid heights
- **Trap:** Hand-picking an innermost turn or trusting a single local estimator on a telescoped core.
- **Evidence:** No clean innermost U or slit is visible at L2 in a single z-slice. Least-squares point closest to all structure-tensor normal lines per 160-slice band, smoothed: residual median 117 vox, p90 218 vox; two objectives differ by 200-800 vox (2-7 mm) for 3000<z<11500 and 1000-1600 vox at the ends; the axis lies outside the papyrus for z <= 1696 and z >= 12896. Local 8.6 mm fits jumped 4-9 mm between bands and a chevron-seam detector scattered ~1k vox: both rejected.
- **Fix:** Use the smoothed curvature-centre curve, validate it on >= 10 z-sections and radial-alignment maps, keep loss_weight_umbilicus modest, and check innermost fitted windings before trusting turn counts.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/units/U2-umbilicus.md

### L118. Winding-count settings must satisfy num_windings >= shell_outer_winding_idx + 3
- **Trap:** Using defaults where shell_outer_winding_idx equals model_gap_expander_num_windings (U1's 220/220).
- **Evidence:** The pinned code raises 'shell_outer_winding_idx 220 requires model_gap_expander_num_windings >= 223'; outer papyrus radius reaches 5504 voxels. PHerc0268's winding count is unknown (~90 to ~140 by different estimates).
- **Fix:** Use WINDINGS=223 with shell_outer_winding_idx 220 (or num_windings - 3), model_flow_bounds_radius >= 5600, and shell weights 0 until the winding count is known (a wrong idx pins the wrong winding).
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/BANDS.md, docs/SPIRAL_STUDY.md

### L119. An outer 'air-papyrus boundary' surface at the scroll end is not a reading surface
- **Trap:** Starting outside-in unrolling with a surface taken as the air/papyrus boundary of a block near the end of the roll (under the old y-axis assumption).
- **Evidence:** The first outer PoC block was z 544-1968 (later shown to contain the holder slab z 632-759 and lens-shaped end caps where the axis lies outside the papyrus). Its mean of forward and reverse ink maps put 38 % of pixels at p >= 0.5 with forward/reverse correlation 0.306. The work was removed in a 'clean slate' commit 38 minutes later.
- **Fix:** Settle axis, papyrus extent and umbilicus before choosing any surface; never combine forward and reverse maps; a map where a third of pixels are 'ink' is a texture response.
- **Label:** INFERENCE · **When:** 2026-10-10 · **Sources:** pherc0268:5a1d504:runs/outer_poc_d12/poc_gold.json, runs/outer_poc/block.json; pherc0268:0e5c47d:commit-message; pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/units/U2-umbilicus.md

### L120. Compare a number only with a bar from the same pipeline stage
- **Trap:** A raw spiral-fit "phase lock" was compared with a published bar (2.46) that is measured after snapping and flattening, so the fit was wrongly called a failure.
- **Evidence:** 2000-step fits never ran track_dt (villa starts it at step 10000). Raw phase lock was 0.99-1.00 (random) vs 2.46 for a reference that turned out to be a third party's post-snap-and-flatten mesh. Root-cause analysis found the failure was orientation (inner windings 42 deg off), not phase. Correction recorded in the project log (SUPERSEDED_CLAIMS S1).
- **Fix:** Score geometry with metrics that do not grade m7 against itself: adjacent windings never collapse onto one sheet, raw mesh normal vs CT/m7 structure-tensor orientation, CT profile of the snapped mesh. Always check what processing stage a reference mesh is at before using it as a control.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** dominion:main:docs/LESSONS.md#1, docs/SUPERSEDED_CLAIMS.md#S1; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RESUME_NOW.md; pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/POC.md; pherc0268:c1017ab:commit-message

### L121. villa's spiral-fit defaults assume 30,000 steps: a 2,000-step horizon never switches on track_dt
- **Trap:** Expecting a 2000-step CPU fit to reach the same geometry as the 30,000-step GPU recipe because the loss and probes look converged.
- **Evidence:** gamma = 0.3^(1/H) (fit_spiral.py:2145): summed LR 0.035 vs the recipe's 0.523, and 0.018 vs 0.276 with track_dt on. B16 at step 800 was nearly converged (median probe move 2.7 vox/100 steps) onto a random-phase configuration. Ranked first of three causes of the failed fits (then data quality, then the whole-track window filter). Also: loss_start_track_dt defaults to 10000 (of 30000) and the LR decays to 0.3x over the horizon; fit logs of 2000-step fits show track_dt = 0.0 throughout. track_radius alone gives a track one shared radius (winding identity) but not phase; B16u at step 500 satisfied only 8.2 % of tracks.
- **Fix:** Do not equate a convergence stop with correctness. Order 9 launched 10,000-step fits with optimizer_lr_final_factor 0.6694 (= 0.3^(10000/30000), the recipe's LR curve over its first 10k steps) and track_dt from step 3333; better, run the full recipe on a GPU or first reproduce the PHerc0343 band on CPU.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/POC.md, docs/BANDS.md; pherc0268:3c7ca39:commit-message; pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:tools/spiral_cpu/autopilot.sh, docs/POC.md, docs/FL_SEARCH.md (strip geometry audit); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Spiral-fit fleet: do fitted windings lock onto sheets?)

### L122. A 3-D tracer without an in-loop orientation gate drifts off the sheet
- **Trap:** Growing a surface from a validated seed and trusting the grown area.
- **Evidence:** From the w161 seed trace3d gave 2.33 cm2 at 6.2 deg median orientation, but only the seed plus ~20 generations (1.76 cm2) was one-sheet-consistent; seeded on the recipe's PHerc0343 w048 ground truth, 46 % of grown nodes drifted more than one sheet off. Letting the CT drive growth gave 6.2 cm2 with sheet-crossing contour patterns and a 35 deg orientation error, so CT stop is off by default.
- **Fix:** Add an in-loop orientation gate and validate the tracer on the same ground-truth test (fraction of nodes within one sheet) before using it for search.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/FL_SEARCH.md, tools/fl/trace3d.py, poc/fl/tracer3d_results.json, docs/FL_SEARCH.md (Phase 1); dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (3-D tracer and on-sheet gate for PHerc0268 surfaces (FL_SEARCH phase 1 geometry engines))

### L123. The fit keeps only whole tracks inside its z window: thin windows drop every long vertical track
- **Trap:** Fitting 256-384-slice windows and expecting cross-window continuity from the tracks.
- **Evidence:** load_tracks_from_dbm keeps a track only if zmin >= z_begin and zmax < z_end. Vertical track z extent: p50 20, p90 50, p99 212, max 3466 slices; 8,612-177,956 tracks per 500-slice band cross its edges (2.8 % of all tracks cross a multiple of 500). The PoC investigation ranks this filter (tracks.py:525-531) as the likely cause of the 24-46 vox seams between windows.
- **Fix:** Overlap windows by >= 64 slices (recovers edge tracks in at least one window) and prefer taller windows or a whole-height fit when cross-window continuity matters.
- **Label:** INFERENCE · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/units/U3-tracks.md, docs/POC.md

### L124. The fit failure signature is orientation, not phase: median normal angle 42 deg vs 6 deg for the recipe
- **Trap:** Diagnosing bad windings by phase/offset (and trying to fix them with snap or track_dt) when the surfaces are tilted across sheets.
- **Evidence:** Median angle between mesh normal and m7 structure-tensor normal: our b16 s800/s1100 and b16u s500 windings 42 deg (27-28 deg on clean-sheet nodes); the recipe's meshes 6 deg (5 deg); random 52-60 deg. Snap repairs <= 5 vox offsets only on parallel meshes; on our inner windings it rejects 40 % of offsets and lands between sheets. 200 track_dt steps turned normals by only 4 deg. m7 was registered to the CT within ~1.5 vox (no axis swap or flip) and phase_lock.py passed synthetic controls, so neither was the cause.
- **Fix:** Gate every mesh on normal-vs-structure-tensor orientation (clean-sheet nodes) before snap/render/ink; rule out registration and QA-tool bugs with synthetic controls first.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/POC.md; pherc0268:43e91ca:commit-message

### L125. Where m7 and CT carry clean sheets the CPU fit is already recipe-like: select patches there by a pre-written rule
- **Trap:** Choosing a patch for ink by surface looks after seeing images.
- **Evidence:** In b16 s1100 w160-w169, theta 165-225 deg: clean-sheet angle 6.9 deg, snapped-mesh rejection 0.17, snapped CT(d=0)/mean 1.020, adjacent-winding collisions 0.4 %. The rule written before any image (lowest clean-sheet angle among windings passing the snap gate) picked w161 (5.6 deg, rejection 0.134); its render peaks at layer 33 with neighbour sheets ~16 layers out, and theta 189-225 deg showed single-sheet fibres (~0.5 cm2) while theta 165-189 deg was contorted and excluded.
- **Fix:** Restrict to regions where m7 is clean (27-38 % of core nodes on PHerc0268 vs 87 % on PHerc0343) and fix the selection rule before rendering.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/POC.md

### L126. snap_meshes.py only captures offsets of about +/-3 voxels
- **Trap:** Relying on the snap to repair fits that are several voxels or half a winding off.
- **Evidence:** Reliable capture (>= 87 % of on-sheet nodes back within 2 voxels) only to about +/-3 voxels; +/-5 voxels gives ~60 %.
- **Fix:** Snap only meshes already parallel and within ~3 vox of the sheet; check frac_already_on and the on-sheet fraction before/after.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/PIPELINE.md

### L127. tifxyz row origins of window fits are not multiples of 20: read z_begin from overrides.json
- **Trap:** Rounding a window's row origin to a multiple of 20 when joining fits.
- **Evidence:** Rows sit at z_begin - 160 + 20 r exactly; z_begin - 160 is not a multiple of 20 in 54 of 68 windows, so rounding put rows 4-8 slices off (16 voxels measured on the B15u|B16 seam).
- **Fix:** Take z_begin from the piece spec or the window's overrides.json, never round, and warn when it must be estimated.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/PIPELINE.md; pherc0268:d68b20a:commit-message

### L128. No winnable surface existed in a 103-surface PHerc0268 pool
- **Trap:** Assuming the existing VC3D squares and ring patches already contain a 4 cm2 on-sheet area.
- **Evidence:** Inventory of 103 surfaces (78 VC3D squares, 24 normal-grid ring patches, local ones): the best ring patches (4.4 cm2) scored 8-10 deg but their largest connected ON region was only 0.3-1.4 cm2; a 4.6 cm2 grown sheet had 9/18 tiles on-sheet (~2 cm2).
- **Fix:** Require a contiguous >= 4 cm2 region with >= 80 % ON_SHEET tiles before inking for First Letters; build better surfaces rather than reading marginal ones.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/FL_SEARCH.md; pherc0268:a0774a8:commit-message

### L129. Lasagna flatten settings validated on compact meshes fail on thin strips
- **Trap:** Using the 1000/250/250 (1500-step) flatten config and the 'area kept >= 0.95' gate on window strips.
- **Evidence:** That config was validated only on compact 91x221 meshes; on 13-20-row x ~1655-column strips at 1500 steps sd p95 is 5-8x and shear p95 3x worse than the full schedule. 'Area kept >= 0.95' fails thin strips by geometry alone (border band ~10-20 voxels).
- **Fix:** Use 3000-6500 steps on strips until validated on a real winding; gate distortion on core rows only.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/PIPELINE.md

### L130. Never fit a window thinner than 256 slices with the default track_walk, and keep step_wv at 2.0
- **Trap:** Shrinking windows to 128 slices or coarsening dense_spacing_target_step_wv to save time.
- **Evidence:** track_walk fails at step 0 on 128-slice windows (B14); dense_spacing_target_step_wv 4.0 undercounts sheet crossings by 4-7 % (B14), so variant S1 was rejected.
- **Fix:** fit_window.sh refuses windows under 256 slices; keep step_wv 2.0.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-11 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/BANDS.md; pherc0268:7b89dd1:commit-message

### L131. Independent z-window fits do not stitch: seams of 8-56 voxels and winding indices that disagree by 3-15 sheets
- **Trap:** Joining windings from separate window fits by their index (w###) or expecting the seams to agree.
- **Evidence:** No villa tool joins z-windows (the organizers fit the whole height in one run). After snap the window seams were 8-56 vox (no stitched sheet); the investigation saw 24-46 vox seams. In the mass run the same winding index lay 3-15 sheets apart in adjacent units; only one patch pair shared a sheet.
- **Fix:** Match windings across windows by geometry in the overlap (seam distance per winding offset, chained offsets checked for closure) before any cross-window use; refuse a join unless the best offset is 0; prefer a whole-height fit.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-14 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/FL_SEARCH.md, docs/PIPELINE.md; pherc0268:a0774a8:commit-message; dominion:main:docs/LESSONS.md#15

### L132. Window-fit strips are 1.7-2.9 mm tall: far too short for a letter test
- **Trap:** Fleet z windows of 2-3 mm gave strips about one letter tall; 13-row strips halve real ink (pre-registered recall 0.39); the First Letters bar needs >= 10 legible letters in 4 cm^2.
- **Evidence:** Every unit fit covers ~256-384 vox of z. Of the 56 mass-run strips, 40 are about 1.8 mm valid (240/260 px renders) and 16 about 2.9 mm (380/400 px) (dominion:main:docs/SUPERSEDED_CLAIMS.md#S6; the FL_SEARCH audit lists 39 short strips of 12-14 node rows, 1.7-1.9 mm, + 16 tall of 19-20 rows, 2.8-2.9 mm). The PoC v0 patch was 2.19 mm tall; the recipe's readable PHerc0343 segment was 13 mm tall.
- **Fix:** Test ink only on surfaces >= 10 mm tall (stack >= 5 windows with passing seams) or a native 4 cm2 patch; report strip height next to any null.
- **Label:** MEASURED · **When:** 2026-10-14 · **Sources:** pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/FL_SEARCH.md, docs/POC.md; dominion:main:docs/LESSONS.md#21, docs/RESULTS.md#1, docs/SUPERSEDED_CLAIMS.md#S6

### L133. Extrapolated padding can step from a hole marker
- **Trap:** In the X13 arm, a hole next to the boundary row made the extrapolation step from the hole marker (-1), so its 2 padding nodes fell far off the sheet in one column.
- **Evidence:** RESULTS 1 (strip r94-107 of the public control, column 39; xpad fixed after the run; X13 recall 0.502, r 0.849, E 20.5).
- **Fix:** Mask invalid (-1) nodes before extrapolating mesh rows, and unit-test extrapolation next to holes.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-10-14 · **Sources:** dominion:main:docs/RESULTS.md#1

**Rendering (L134-L164).** Surface volumes, depth order, mirror state, flattening, display scaling and strip cutting: how a correct surface still becomes a wrong image.

### L134. Organizer 9 um surface volumes have 28 slices; the surface lies between slices 13 and 14
- **Trap:** Comparing a single render slice with organizer SV slice 14 (off by half a slice) or assuming the catalogue tifxyz_original grid equals the SV grid.
- **Evidence:** Official renderer centre is 0.5 (n - 1); N9 canvas = mesh grid x 20 = SV shape for the <id>-on-<volume> meshes; the catalogue's tifxyz_original has a different grid. Alignment gate compared our slice n//2 of -n 31 with the mean of organizer slices 13 and 14 and got NCC 0.960-0.973 at shift 0 on 0841 J windows.
- **Fix:** Compare your centre slice against the mean of organizer slices 13-14; use the <id>-on-<volume> mesh grid x 20 as canvas.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-24 · **Sources:** dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md#B0841-BANK, #DECL-D1-A1, #TEXT-ORDER-D1; dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5@a1f9f4635:logs/pipeline/w040_smoke.json, logs/pipeline/w040_smoke_zasc_c-1.json, CHANGELOG.md; dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json (Window render pipeline smoke test)

### L135. Name the depth order by the render frame, never by the word 'reverse'
- **Trap:** Assuming the official 'reverse' (or 'forward') order is the text order. The same text order is FORWARD on a --flip-normals render and REVERSE on an unflipped render, so a pipeline that copies an order name from older records maps the wrong side.
- **Evidence:** PHerc0139 2.4 um control (0.185 cm^2 scored): a vc_render_tifxyz -n 63 --flip-normals render equals the organizer surface volume slices 23..85 (pooled Pearson 0.999997-0.999998; best unflipped r 0.22). On it the official FORWARD order reproduces the organizer ink map at r 0.999986 (AUC 0.88795 vs the organizer map's 0.88798) while official REVERSE has AUC 0.47070 (no signal). The unflipped render is the exact slice-reverse of the flipped one, and official REVERSE on it gives AUC 0.883. Also: PHerc0814: our -n 31 --flip-normals render vs organizer 9.362 um SV gave NCC 0.9968 at the surface, while the opposite direction gave 0.005-0.012. PHerc0841: with --flip-normals the render normal points toward the umbilicus proxy on 98 % of nodes.
- **Fix:** Declare the order as 'the order in which the official code reproduces the organizer map on a render whose slice stack matches the organizer surface volume'. Before any map is trusted, run both orders on a labelled control and check which one reproduces the organizer map (r > 0.99).
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25..2026-09-26 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-chain2um:logs/sib/chain2um/REPORT.md, logs/sib/chain2um/chain2um_results.json, README.md; dominion:sib-pairs0814:logs/sib/pairs0814/REPORT.md; dominion:sib-reg0841:logs/sib/reg0841/chainvalid/REPORT.md

### L136. Decide mirror state from geometry, not from readers
- **Trap:** Showing readers both mirror states and asking which is legible; flipping because acquisition z descends.
- **Evidence:** Rule: mirror state = sign(det[dP/du, dP/dv, r_out]) x frame parity (left_handed_coordinates). Synthetic planted glyphs: 32/32 unmirrored under the rule, wrong-sign control mirrored 32/32. 114/114 organizer affines have det sign matching the parity flags; three same-scroll pairs with opposite acquisition z have det > 0 (descending z is not a mirror). All organizer meshes of PHerc0139 (38), PHerc0009B (18), PHerc0841 (3) and PHerc0800 (6) read unmirrored as stored. The reader-based HANDED bar had failed three times at chance.
- **Fix:** Use the packaged rule (handcheck; 112 tests) with r_out from the official umbilicus, else a centroid cross-checked against the normal-line centre; keep both mirror states only for FLAG meshes.
- **Label:** VERIFIED · **When:** 2026-09-25..2026-09-30 · **Sources:** dominion:sib-handed:logs/sib/handed/REPORT.md, logs/sib/handed/handed_summary.json, README.md; dominion:sib-handed@81d525859:logs/sib/handed/handed_summary.json (synthetic.rule_unmirrored), logs/sib/handed/handed_summary.json (synthetic.wrong_sign_mirrored), logs/sib/handed/REPORT.md (section 5.1), logs/sib/handed/REPORT.md (section 5.2)

### L137. The distributed grid flattening fails isometry; ABF++ can collapse; SLIM is the safe re-flattener
- **Trap:** Assuming the tifxyz grid canvas (or official ABF++) is a low-distortion flattening for letter reading.
- **Evidence:** flatcheck on public PHerc0139 9.362 um meshes: whole-mesh grid flattening has 90.05 / 92.94 / 91.83 % of quads within +-5 % (bar 93.1 %); SLIM and ARAP improve 9/9 windows by 5.1-18.1 points; in the most curved window of each mesh no method reaches 93.1 % (angle defects 0.87-1.26 deg). Earlier study: windows reaching 93.1 % ABF++ 0/10, SLIM 3/10, ARAP 4/10; SLIM >= ABF++ in 33 of 33 (8 ties); ABF++ collapsed on one whole mesh to 27.9 % (LSCM shrink, rescale x2.58, 3 fold-overs) where SLIM gave 98.1 %; ARAP folded in 4 of 9 windows, SLIM never.
- **Fix:** Score every flattening per quad (area-normalised +-5 % edge test, fold-overs, rescale outside [1/1.5, 1.5]); re-flatten with SLIM on windows (about 4 s per 4 cm^2 at 9 um, 4-6 min at 2.4 um; whole 57 cm^2 meshes did not finish in 12 min); report intrinsic curvature as the ceiling.
