### Data sources we relied on

- **Vesuvius Challenge open data.** `s3://vesuvius-challenge-open-data/`, anonymous S3, CC BY-NC 4.0. A licence acceptance must reach the computing session directly ([L017](#l017-a-data-licence-acceptance-must-reach-the-session-that-uses-the-data-directly)).
  - Volumes are zarr pyramids whose levels are exact 2x2x2 means ([L009](#l009-pyramid-levels-are-exact-2x2x2-means-get-the-half-voxel-offset-right)). Read the voxel size and protocol from each `metadata.json` ([L010](#l010-read-voxel-size-and-protocol-from-each-volumes-own-metadatajson)): JULY is 9.362 um, MAY is 8.64 um.
  - Paris 4 has scans at 2.4 um and 1.129 um, plus 78/137 keV scans ([L020](#l020-78137-kev-dual-energy-on-the-published-paris-4-scans-units-fail-registration-is-critical-and-only-cuasau-are-reachable)). Its published volume is SAM2-masked ([L030](#l030-the-published-paris-4-volume-is-sam2-masked-so-anything-outside-the-scroll-body-is-gone)).
  - PHerc0841 has volumes at 9.366 and 2.403 um. Only PHerc1203 and PHerc0846A have rescans ([L004](#l004-catalogue-facts-that-differ-from-the-fact-sheet-sept-2026)).
  - Missing chunks are unobserved data ([L015](#l015-missing-ct-chunks-masquerade-as-blank-papyrus)).
- **Organizer products.**
  - Segments are tifxyz meshes, and they are not automatically clean ([L098](#l098-organizer-segments-are-not-automatically-clean-filter-snapshots-and-check-self-crossings)).
  - Surface volumes: the 9 um ones have 28 slices, with the surface between slices 13 and 14 ([L134](#l134-organizer-9-um-surface-volumes-have-28-slices-the-surface-lies-between-slices-13-and-14)). The 2.4 um ones are about 32 GB per segment.
  - Official ink predictions exist, but none on the First Letters eligible volumes ([L029](#l029-no-official-ink-predictions-exist-on-the-first-letters-eligible-volumes)). Ink labels carry no letter identities ([L007](#l007-official-ink-labels-carry-no-letter-identities)), and PHerc0841's 'validation' layer is a coverage mask ([L002](#l002-official-pherc0841-label-layers-validation-is-a-coverage-mask-not-a-held-out-split)).
  - Normal grids total 386.9 GB; sync whole planes per volume ([L006](#l006-sync-whole-normal-grid-planes-per-volume-per-seed-partial-syncs-save-almost-nothing)). The m7 surface prediction is binary ([L047](#l047-m7-is-effectively-binary-the-sdt-threshold-choice-is-moot)).
  - Spiral tracks exist for 18 of 23 eligible volumes. PHerc0268's stop at z = 4500 ([L049](#l049-published-pherc0268-spiral-tracks-stop-at-z--4500-regenerate-the-missing-21--with-the-organizers-own-extractor)); read them with HTTP range reads ([L041](#l041-extract-one-z-band-of-the-25-gb-published-tracks-with-http-range-reads-instead-of-downloading-everything)).
  - Do not trust the landmark `transform.json` at sub-voxel level ([L012](#l012-do-not-trust-the-buckets-landmark-transformjson-at-sub-voxel-level)).
- **Prize pages.** The scrollprize docs (`docs/34_prizes.md`) and the live prize page. Re-fetch them before relying on them ([L001](#l001-read-the-prize-rules-section-by-section-with-file-and-line), [L359](#l359-re-fetch-the-prize-page-and-licence-terms-before-relying-on-the-catalogue)).
- **Literature.** Cronache Ercolanesi 54 (2024) gives the Paris 4 layout ([L032](#l032-published-paris-4-layout-cronache-ercolanesi-54-2024)). The title dossier draws on Cavallo 1983 and on attested initial and verso titles ([L282](#l282-where-herculaneum-titles-are-scholarly-priors-for-title-searches), [L229](#l229-initial-titles-exist-search-both-ends-of-a-roll)).
- **Third-party public data.** Erwin Nieuwlaar's public PHerc0343 First Letters segment (13 known letters) served as the release's positive control. The owner approved it for that use only.

### Models we relied on

- **`scrollprize/ink_9um`** (hybrid_3d2d, seed 42 and 43, step 75,000). This is the base 9 um model. Forward order = render slices 7..23 ascending of an `-n 31` render ([L174](#l174-base-ink9um-depth-order-convention-forward--render-slices-723-ascending-of-an--n-31-render)). Do not use `--tta-mirror` ([L169](#l169-do-not-use---tta-mirror-with-the-base-ink9um-checkpoint-it-lowers-forward-auc-below-the-regression-bar)). Its 3-D stem is the CPU bottleneck ([L168](#l168-the-3-d-stem-of-the-9-um-ink-model-is-the-cpu-bottleneck)), and Paris 4's 8 labelled segments are in its training set ([L028](#l028-the-8-paris-4-labelled-segments-are-in-ink9ums-training-set)).
- **Hecate 9.6 um** (official). Screened out on PHerc0841 (0.678 against 0.75). It runs 42-47x slower than villa ink maps on CPU ([L165](#l165-hecate-96-um-screened-out-on-pherc0841), [L194](#l194-hecate-is-42-47x-slower-than-a-villa-ink-map-on-cpu)).
- **2.4 um canonical ink model** (official). It runs silently in bf16 on CPU ([L180](#l180-the-24-um-canonical-ink-model-silently-runs-in-bf16-on-cpu)).
- **PHerc.1667 iterations 0-5** (official, cross-scroll). They were the only checkpoints eligible for Paris 4, and they were blind on it ([L176](#l176-a-cross-scroll-ink-model-can-be-completely-blind-on-a-new-scroll-gate-it-on-that-scrolls-known-text-first)). Keep torchvision and timm out of their environment ([L475](#l475-keep-torchvisiontimm-out-of-the-hf-environment-for-pherc1667-checkpoints)). Run iteration 4 in fp32, because bf16 fails equivalence.
- **Grand Prize TimeSformer.** Run it through the organizers' code with a voxel scale factor of voxel / 7.91 ([L188](#l188-run-the-grand-prize-timesformer-through-the-organizers-code-and-scale-match-the-voxel-size)). It saturated on PHerc0268 (46-59 % ink).
- **Screened and ineligible for Paris 4.** ink_3d_dino_guided, timesformer, resnet50 and fiber ([L175](#l175-check-each-checkpoints-documented-training-data-before-any-inference-eligibility-is-a-documentation-check)).
- **`Nieuwlaar/ink9um-dense-native`** (step 16,000, third party).
  - It had the best reference AUC on a held-out 8.64 um scroll (0.7605).
  - It was withdrawn from the First Letters push under the data-use rule, and later used in the release control under the owner's override.
  - Rebuild it from the published files and verify ([L508](#l508-rebuild-third-party-checkpoints-from-published-files-and-verify)).
- **P4-OWN.** Our own model, 232,697 parameters, trained from scratch on Paris 4 labels ([L183](#l183-a-small-cnn-trained-from-scratch-on-the-scrolls-own-labels-detects-its-ink-where-a-cross-scroll-model-failed)).
- **Readers.** Claude models in sealed-output mode, named "fable" (calibrated) and "opus" in the record. Changing the reader model voids the calibration ([L279](#l279-changing-the-reader-model-voids-the-reader-calibration)).

### Glossary

- **2 x 2 cm tile / 4 x 4 cm window**: what readers were shown. A tile is a crop of a flattened map; a window is stitched from tiles ([L288](#l288-stitch-tiles-into-4-x-4-cm-windows-for-the-census-then-re-test-every-window-hit-at-tile-scale)).
- **AMX**: Intel CPU matrix extensions. Without them, bf16 is about 2x slower ([L404](#l404-check-for-amx-before-choosing-bf16-on-cpu-without-it-bf16-is-2x-slower)).
- **AP / AUC / FPR**: average precision / area under the ROC curve / false-positive rate. Pixel AUC scores pixels against labels; box AUC scores letter boxes against the rest.
- **agreed / agreed-firm**: a letter named by 2 or more of 3 readers within 150 px. It is firm if all 3 named it, or if 2 did and both marked it firm.
- **arm**: one condition of a test. NULL = label-scrambled, REV = depth-reversed, CTRL = replay-only, CHANCE = the reader chance arm.
- **bf16 / fp32**: numeric precisions; ink maps stayed fp32 ([L414](#l414-bf16-amx-inference-is-not-accurate-enough-for-ink-maps-fp32-cpu-inference-is-cheap-enough)).
- **blank margin**: all-zero rows that `vc_render_tifxyz` leaves at the edges of thin strips ([L249](#l249-the-blank-margin-bug-partly-blank-inference-patches-create-or-suppress-ink)).
- **C_net**: the chance-corrected net letter count against a 5,000-permutation identity null.
- **C3**: the fidelity gate of the 9 um base ink chain against the organizer map.
- **canary**: a known-text panel in a reading session that proves the reader can read.
- **census / phase 2 / extended test**: a census is a blind read of all tiles of a region. Phase 2 re-reads the positives. The extended test confirms a candidate against a rotated self-null and 40 or more null tiles ([L321](#l321-a-4-tile-null-manufactures-leads-a-rotated-self-null-plus--40-null-tiles-kills-them)).
- **CErc 54**: Cronache Ercolanesi 54 (2024), the published Paris 4 edition and layout.
- **CHAIN VALID**: the gate that our render-plus-ink chain reproduces the organizer map.
- **clearance / exclusion margin**: the minimum 3-D distance from training labels or sealed windows (e.g. 1.2 mm for P4, 144 vox for D3).
- **CORR-RETRACE-RULE**: the same-papyrus rule, vertex OR point-to-surface ([L059](#l059-literal-nearest-vertex-re-trace-checks-miss-re-traces-use-vertex-or-point-to-surface-corr-retrace-rule)).
- **D1 / D2 / D3 / D4**: the day-0 decisions.
  - D1: zero-shot blind read of 9 um maps on PHerc0841.
  - D2: pooled 9 to 2.4 um training.
  - D3: fold-0841 fine-tune.
  - D4: a bootstrap benchmark (void).
- **d (depth)**: the ink-model layer offset from the surface. On a 66-layer render the models read layers 25 + d to 41 + d.
- **DECL-X / -A1 / -E1**: a declaration in RULES.md made before its data, then its amendment and its erratum.
- **depth order (forward / reverse)**: the slice order fed to the model. Name it by the render frame ([L135](#l135-name-the-depth-order-by-the-render-frame-never-by-the-word-reverse)).
- **DEV-LOOP / FINALIST / sigma_eq / sigma_crit**: the planned model-development loop. sigma_eq is the reference blur that best matches a model map. sigma_crit is the largest blur at which reference reads keep 50 % of their letters. A finalist needs sigma_eq <= sigma_crit + 0.05 mm on 3 or more DEV scrolls.
- **DONE hand-back**: the only allowed reply of a sealed reader. Anything else is an integrity event ([L376](#l376-hand-backs-other-than-done-are-integrity-events-even-when-harmless)).
- **E2E-1**: the end-to-end band run on PHerc0268 (trace, mesh, render, ink).
- **First Letters / First Title / Progress / Grand Prize**: the Vesuvius Challenge prize tracks. First Letters needs 10 letters in 4 cm2 of an eligible volume.
- **FL-1 ... FL-7**: the First Letters declarations (DECL-FL-n). FL6-RESULT closed the push.
- **G1**: P4-OWN's blind legibility gate (bar 30 %).
- **GO marker**: an explicit release signal for a costly run ([L418](#l418-gate-a-costly-run-behind-an-explicit-go-marker-and-record-whether-the-gate-was-ever-released)).
- **GP model**: the Grand Prize TimeSformer ink model.
- **grow / seed planner**: automatic surface growth from seeds (GrowPatch). The planner fixes the seed positions ([L392](#l392-a-deterministic-seed-planner-with-a-fixed-plan-cannot-be-extended-by-re-running-it)).
- **handedness / mirror state**: whether a render is mirrored. Settle it by geometry (handed-1/2 rules, CT-occupancy frame gate), never by votes ([L136](#l136-decide-mirror-state-from-geometry-not-from-readers), [L056](#l056-verify-that-a-mesh-lies-on-the-scroll-in-its-declared-frame-ct-occupancy-frame-gate)).
- **injection-recovery**: planting a synthetic signal into real control CT to measure a detection limit ([L210](#l210-an-analytic-detection-limit-is-not-an-exclusion-a-lane-without-injection-recovery-has-no-verdict)).
- **J seal / S'**: the consensus seal of reader-agreed letters over five held-out PHerc0841 windows (J1-J5). S' is its size: 20, of which 9 firm ([L262](#l262-a-seal-made-by-readers-measures-what-readers-perceive-not-ground-truth), [L308](#l308-small-sealed-sets-cap-statistical-power-j-seal-s--20-forced-pmax--0005)).
- **JULY / MAY**: the scan protocol families (9.362 um and 8.64 um voxels).
- **K1**: a pre-declared kill rule. K1 JULY closes 9 um letter reading with current models if D1 does not pass, D2 fails or is not run, and D3 does not pass.
- **K-edge / dual energy / XRF**: element-specific absorption, two-energy CT and X-ray fluorescence, all ways to look for pigments ([L020](#l020-78137-kev-dual-energy-on-the-published-paris-4-scans-units-fail-registration-is-critical-and-only-cuasau-are-reachable)).
- **KTLB**: the project's sealed known-text reading benchmarks (KTLB-3R = D1; KTLB-4-0841, KTLB-4P and KTLB-M were planned).
- **lane / sibling / sub-sibling / orchestrator / owner**: a worker branch and session / a worker session / a worker started by a worker / the session that keeps the research log / the human director.
- **lasagna**: the organizers' layered normal-field representation and flatten tool used by the spiral fit ([L042](#l042-lasagna-groupscale-must-be-paired-normalzarrgroup-2---lasagnascale-4-the-defaults-misregister-silently), [L045](#l045-lasagna-normals-are-not-ct-masked-and-under-represent-z-dominant-sheet-normals)).
- **m7**: the organizers' binary surface-prediction volume (0/255, 6 levels, 192^3 chunks) ([L047](#l047-m7-is-effectively-binary-the-sdt-threshold-choice-is-moot)).
- **METRIC-HASH**: a log entry that pins a scorer by hash before use.
- **N0 / rotated self-null**: N0 tiles are census tiles shown rotated 90 degrees; the threshold is max(5, p99 of N0). The rotated self-null is the candidate itself rotated ([L334](#l334-in-the-extended-test-the-rotated-self-arm-not-n0-is-the-strict-control)).
- **NCC / PSF / RMS / r**: normalized cross-correlation, point-spread function, root-mean-square error, Pearson r.
- **NO-DATA**: missing CT (404 chunks, zero pixels). It is unobserved, never blank ([L015](#l015-missing-ct-chunks-masquerade-as-blank-papyrus)).
- **normal grids**: the organizers' per-volume planes of sheet normals that a grower needs ([L100](#l100-grows-without-normal-grids-are-data-independent-know-the-failure-signatures)).
- **ORD-3 / OBS-SURVEY**: the ordered-stack sheet tracker on PHerc0268, and its observability survey ([L115](#l115-local-sheet-identity-tracking-at-864-um-fails-across-the-whole-of-pherc0268)).
- **Orders (pherc0268)**: the numbered, timestamped orders to the spiral-fit swarm in `docs/BANDS.md`. Orders 6 and 9 followed owner decisions ([L398](#l398-a-broadcast-orders-section-plus-direct-one-shot-triggers-is-how-a-68-unit-swarm-was-steered)).
- **OSO-n**: an owner standing order in the research log.
- **P4 channels**: the Paris 4 search channels.
  - Organizer predictions and geometry: P4-C (census of official predictions), P4-D (core), P4-M (layout).
  - Raw-CT displays: P4-E (raw-CT census), P4-H (crackle), P4-I (row structure), P4-L (thin slab), P4-W (block detector).
  - Composition: P4-F (dense pigment).
  - Models: P4-O (cross-scroll checkpoints), P4-OWN (own model).
  - Other: P4-OFF (verso offset), P4-TAG (detached tags).
- **PHerc NNNN**: a Herculaneum papyrus catalogue number as used in the data; suffixes (A, B, P, P2) are catalogue volume or part labels. PHerc. Paris 4 (Scroll 1) is the First Title target, PHerc0343 the public positive control, and PHerc0268 the unread scroll of the October work.
- **phase lock / snap / track_dt / T0**: spiral-fit terms.
  - Phase lock is the alignment of fitted windings with m7 sheets. About 1.0 is random, and the 2.46 reference was measured after snap and flatten ([L120](#l120-compare-a-number-only-with-a-bar-from-the-same-pipeline-stage)).
  - Snap (`snap_meshes.py`) pulls meshes onto sheets within about +-3 vox ([L126](#l126-snapmeshespy-only-captures-offsets-of-about--3-voxels)).
  - track_dt is a track loss that the recipe switches on at step 10,000 of 30,000 ([L121](#l121-villas-spiral-fit-defaults-assume-30000-steps-a-2000-step-horizon-never-switches-on-trackdt)).
  - T0 is the low-z track extraction.
- **pre-registration**: declaring the question, material, controls, bars and decision rule before the data exists ([L297](#l297-declare-before-data-pin-code-by-hash-and-keep-an-append-only-hash-chained-log)).
- **READ-CAL / PROBE-1/2/3 / REF ladder**: reader-and-display calibration on known text. The REF ladder blurs reference maps to find the legibility limit ([L268](#l268-calibrated-legibility-falls-smoothly-with-blur-maps-need-an-effective-blur-of--030-mm-to-be-read)).
- **recto / verso / winding / lamina / sheet pitch**: writing face / back / one turn of the roll / one papyrus layer / sheet spacing measured along the normal ([L080](#l080-normal-spacing-not-radial-fit-spacing-is-the-sheet-pitch)).
- **research log**: `RULES.md` on `claude/gifted-bell-gavnl5`, append-only and hash-chained.
- **rows Y/N**: a reader's answer to "does this show rows of writing?"
- **SAM2 mask**: the segmentation mask of the published Paris 4 volume. Anything outside the scroll body is removed ([L030](#l030-the-published-paris-4-volume-is-sam2-masked-so-anything-outside-the-scroll-body-is-gone)).
- **SDT**: signed distance transform of the surface prediction, an input to the spiral fit ([L445](#l445-sdt-bands-must-be-aligned-to-the-512-working-slice-tile-rows-and-must-cover-the-fit-window)).
- **sealed-output mode**: reader answers are age-encrypted, and only the scorer holds the key ([L356](#l356-a-subagents-final-answer-leaks-into-the-orchestrator-context-use-sealed-output-mode-for-any-blind-reader)).
- **SG / SG-FEAS**: the mechanical submission gate, and its feasibility bar (12 or more agreed letters, 8 or more firm).
- **shuffle null**: the identity-shuffle permutation null for reader agreement ([L270](#l270-inter-reader-agreement-against-a-shuffle-null-is-a-usable-legibility-statistic-and-here-it-showed-reader-namings-were-mostly-idiosyncratic)).
- **SLIM / ABF++ / ARAP**: flattening methods. SLIM is the safe one ([L137](#l137-the-distributed-grid-flattening-fails-isometry-abf-can-collapse-slim-is-the-safe-re-flattener)).
- **surface volume (SV)**: CT layers sampled along a mesh's normals.
- **tifxyz**: the organizers' mesh format of x, y, z grids ([L127](#l127-tifxyz-row-origins-of-window-fits-are-not-multiples-of-20-read-zbegin-from-overridesjson)).
- **TRIBUNAL**: the planted-fault and pre-read gate suites ([L197](#l197-plant-real-faults-before-trusting-a-pre-read-gate)).
- **TTA**: test-time (mirror) augmentation. Do not use it with ink_9um ([L169](#l169-do-not-use---tta-mirror-with-the-base-ink9um-checkpoint-it-lowers-forward-auc-below-the-regression-bar)).
- **U1-U4**: the PHerc0268 pathfinder units: CPU fit port, umbilicus, band extraction, SDT.
- **umbilicus**: the central axis line of a rolled scroll ([L117](#l117-pherc0268-umbilicus-is-a-curvature-centre-estimate-good-to-only-2-7-mm-at-mid-heights)).
- **VC3D / volume-cartographer**: the organizers' segmentation and rendering software in villa.
- **villa**: the ScrollPrize monorepo (`vesuvius` package, volume-cartographer).
- **void / null / uninformative**: invalid material or procedure / ran as declared and found nothing / ran, but its gate or control failed, so the null means nothing ([L283](#l283-a-0-positive-census-under-a-gate-that-never-passed-is-uninformative)).

## Part 6. Timeline, start to finish

The programme ran for 22 days in eight overlapping phases. Dates are 2026 and times UTC. Each phase lists what was tried, learned and decided, with links to the lessons that hold the detail. "RULES.md" is the research log `dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:RULES.md`.

### Phase 0. Set-up (24 September)

**Tried:**

- An append-only, hash-chained decision log, with every bar declared and pushed before its data ([L297](#l297-declare-before-data-pin-code-by-hash-and-keep-an-append-only-hash-chained-log), [L360](#l360-commit-and-push-declarations-before-launching-any-reader-run-an-independent-auditor-before-recording-a-verdict)).
- The prompt had promised 8 GPUs, but the container had 4 CPU cores, 15 GB RAM, 30 GB free disk and no GPU. All decision dates were re-declared ([L406](#l406-check-the-provisioned-hardware-before-planning-the-prompt-assumed-8-gpus-the-container-had-4-cpus-and-no-gpu)).
- A sealed-output reader harness (age-encrypted answers, DONE hand-back, code audit) was adopted after a live test ([L275](#l275-sealed-read-harness-commit-keys-and-briefs-before-any-reader-never-let-the-harness-see-answers), [L356](#l356-a-subagents-final-answer-leaks-into-the-orchestrator-context-use-sealed-output-mode-for-any-blind-reader)).
- The prize rules were read with file and line ([L001](#l001-read-the-prize-rules-section-by-section-with-file-and-line)). Catalogue facts that differed from the fact sheet were logged ([L004](#l004-catalogue-facts-that-differ-from-the-fact-sheet-sept-2026)).

**Learned:**

- The agent harness silently resamples images larger than 1068 px ([L259](#l259-agent-harness-silently-resamples-images-larger-than-1068-px-per-side)).
- On clean PHerc0139 reference maps, the READ-CAL picker found 0 qualifying windows ("SG infeasible at current display"). Blind AI readers could not read even official maps without calibration ([L258](#l258-blind-llm-readers-named-almost-no-letters-in-official-0139-reference-maps-at-9-um-canvas-scale-without-calibration)).

**Decided:** Every reader image is capped at 1068 px, and reading waits for calibration.

Sources: RULES.md `#D0-HW`, `#HARNESS-SEALED-TEST`, `#D0-PRIZE-CHECK`, `#HARNESS-COORD`, `#RCPICK-1`.

### Phase 1. Can blind readers read 9 um ink maps? (24-26 September; PHerc0139, PHerc0841)

**Tried:**

- **C3 fidelity gate.** Run 1 was VOID: a metric defect, plus an undisclosed prior map ([L303](#l303-one-whole-canvas-map-silently-consumes-every-fresh-held-out-crop-of-that-segment)). With mirror TTA the forward AUC was 0.97795 against a 0.987 bar. Without TTA, on a never-mapped segment, it was 0.99960, a pass ([L169](#l169-do-not-use---tta-mirror-with-the-base-ink9um-checkpoint-it-lowers-forward-auc-below-the-regression-bar)).
- **Handedness by reader vote.** It was AMBIGUOUS three times, because readers cannot tell maps from their mirror images ([L257](#l257-blind-readers-cannot-tell-reference-maps-from-their-mirror-images-handedness-cannot-be-fixed-by-reader-votes)). The geometric handed-1/2 rule was validated 32/32 on synthetic data instead ([L136](#l136-decide-mirror-state-from-geometry-not-from-readers)).
- **READ-CAL probes.**
  - PROBE-1 (36 readers, 3 displays x 2 reader models x 2 mirror states): at most 4 agreed letters per window, 0 firm, no window above the shuffle null ([L270](#l270-inter-reader-agreement-against-a-shuffle-null-is-a-usable-legibility-statistic-and-here-it-showed-reader-namings-were-mostly-idiosyncratic)).
  - PROBE-2 added a Greek key sheet. One cell met the bar exactly (5 agreed, p 0.031), but on reused windows ([L267](#l267-a-font-rendered-greek-key-sheet-shown-first-makes-blind-readers-agree-beyond-chance-kd2-display-fable-model)).
  - PROBE-3 replicated it on fresh papyrus (10 agreed, p 1/2001), still with 0 firm letters in the primary arm and a signal insensitive to mirroring ([L269](#l269-reader-agreement-beyond-the-identity-shuffle-null-is-not-proof-of-correct-letters-agreed-identities-are-dominated-by-simple-symmetric-shapes)).
  - READ-CAL was frozen.
- **J seal on PHerc0841.** S' = 20 (9 firm) over five held-out windows, committed by hash before any project render ([L262](#l262-a-seal-made-by-readers-measures-what-readers-perceive-not-ground-truth), [L308](#l308-small-sealed-sets-cap-statistical-power-j-seal-s--20-forced-pmax--0005)).
- **Hecate 9.6 um screen.** Screened out at best-order AUC 0.678 against a 0.75 bar ([L165](#l165-hecate-96-um-screened-out-on-pherc0841)).
- **D1.** Eighteen calibrated readers named 0 letters on every sealed window and blank, in the base, raw-CT and chance arms. The base map's pixel AUC on those windows was 0.733. Verdict FAIL; the audit passed 4/4 ([L196](#l196-the-base-9-um-model-detects-unseen-scroll-ink-at-pixel-level-auc-073-but-its-maps-are-not-letter-legible)).
- **D3 fine-tune.** It was feasible: 306 text tiles against a bar of 280, and 1.69 h per CPU arm. Four arms went through 24 sealed reads, and every arm scored 0 net letters, although readers named 3-13 letters on a known-text canary. Verdict NOT PASSED on 26 September at 10:19Z ([L167](#l167-fine-tuning-the-9-um-base-model-on-nearby-same-scroll-papyrus-did-not-make-unseen-text-legible)).
- **D2.** Never trained: with no GPU, 148.75 s/step at 384 px meant 20.7 days per arm ([L423](#l423-full-forward-384-px-training-of-the-9-um-model-is-not-feasible-on-cpu), [L416](#l416-measure-throughput-before-committing-to-a-training-programme)).

**Learned:**

- Pixel AUC near 0.73 is far from legible; maps need an effective blur of about 0.30 mm or less ([L268](#l268-calibrated-legibility-falls-smoothly-with-blur-maps-need-an-effective-blur-of--030-mm-to-be-read)).
- Agreement beyond a shuffle null is consistency, not correctness ([L269](#l269-reader-agreement-beyond-the-identity-shuffle-null-is-not-proof-of-correct-letters-agreed-identities-are-dominated-by-simple-symmetric-shapes)).
- A canary in each session separates reader failure from an empty map ([L211](#l211-run-the-positive-control-first-on-enough-material-and-with-cell-level-ink-labels)).

**Decided:** The K1 JULY kill rule (stop 9 um letter reading with current models) had two of its three conditions met. The third, D2 NOT RUN, falls due on 2026-11-15 unless a GPU appears (`dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:STATE.md`).

Sources: RULES.md `#C3-NT-R1-VERDICT`, `#READCAL-FREEZE`, `#SEAL-J-D1`, `#D1-VERDICT`, `#D3-FEAS-RESULT`; `dominion:sib-d2-null:README.md`.

### Phase 2. Sibling fleet and infrastructure lanes (25 September - 2 October)

**Tried:** 118 sibling sessions were registered on 95 branches ([L353](#l353-parallel-agent-fleets-burn-budget-prefer-one-detached-command-per-job)). Their lanes:

- **Registration.** A single affine failed on PHerc0841 (r 0.724, RMS 1.92 vox), and a non-affine field then passed on 16 new patches (r 0.863, RMS 0.977) ([L060](#l060-pherc0841-9366---2403-um-registration-is-non-affine-a-single-affine-fails-held-out-patches)). The PHerc1203 rescan registered by affine; PHerc0846A did not (median r 0.844) ([L061](#l061-rescan-registration-test-flips-and-remounts-first-require-z-consistency-and-expect-affine-to-beat-translation-by-far)).
- **TRIBUNAL.** The nearest-vertex re-trace rule caught 4 of 200 planted re-traces, so CORR-RETRACE-RULE (vertex OR point-to-surface) replaced it ([L059](#l059-literal-nearest-vertex-re-trace-checks-miss-re-traces-use-vertex-or-point-to-surface-corr-retrace-rule), [L197](#l197-plant-real-faults-before-trusting-a-pre-read-gate)).
- **FLAT-1 flattening.** vc_flatten was adopted by rule. No method reached 93.1 % on the hard set, so SLIM was recommended ([L062](#l062-a-flattening-benchmark-must-be-able-to-fail), [L137](#l137-the-distributed-grid-flattening-fails-isometry-abf-can-collapse-slim-is-the-safe-re-flattener)).
- **Factory dry run.** Verifier 16/16, byte-identical output, 6/6 planted faults rejected ([L459](#l459-make-every-package-claim-mechanically-checkable-and-prove-the-verifier-with-planted-faults)). The first drill had passed vacuously ([L199](#l199-a-fault-drill-or-planted-fault-gate-counts-only-if-every-case-is-built-and-fails-its-own-check)).
- **Contamination tooling.** 31 of 437 PHerc0139 pairs were judged SAME. The owner stopped this session directly at about 23:47Z on 25 September. Relayed notices did not lift that stop, and a new branch would have routed around it ([L361](#l361-a-relayed-instruction-does-not-lift-a-direct-owner-stop-continuing-on-a-new-branch-routes-around-it)).
- **Precision and storage.**
  - AMX bf16 was 1.60-1.74x faster but failed the 99.9 % per-pixel bar, so maps stayed fp32 ([L414](#l414-bf16-amx-inference-is-not-accurate-enough-for-ink-maps-fp32-cpu-inference-is-cheap-enough)).
  - Four offload batches (3.39 GB, 1,324 files) went to a hash-chained data branch ([L413](#l413-stream-data-offload-with-a-verified-self-test-keep-under-github-limits)).
  - The trainer passed bitwise tests ([L177](#l177-prove-the-trainer-bitwise-before-any-real-training)).
- **PHerc0814 pairs.** They passed 564/1502 and 235/545 patches, and a shifted-CT control confirmed the 0.8 NCC bar ([L200](#l200-a-shifted-ct-control-shows-whether-an-ncc-alignment-bar-measures-alignment)).
- **DEV-LOOP.** Registry v3 was certified, but after the owner stopped the session, the freeze was never done. Every dependent lane stayed blocked ([L357](#l357-one-unfinished-freeze-step-in-a-shared-metric-harness-blocked-every-dependent-lane)).

**Learned:**

- Infrastructure failures (rate limits, idle kills) were the common failure mode ([L367](#l367-infrastructure-failures-rate-limits-idle-kills-are-the-common-failure-mode)).
- Workers need a tasking channel before they are created ([L363](#l363-workers-need-a-working-tasking-channel-before-they-are-created-and-their-outputs-must-be-merged)), and a dependent lane needs a deadline and a fallback ([L372](#l372-a-dependent-lane-needs-a-deadline-and-a-fallback-not-only-a-waiter)).

**Owner standing orders:**

- **OSO-3 (26 September):** act without asking, but never lower a bar or route around a refusal.
- **OSO-4 (27 September):** nothing waits on the owner. A prompt-regeneration workflow was retired after 1.45 M tokens ([L379](#l379-multi-agent-prompt-regeneration-workflows-can-burn-the-usage-budget)).
- **OSO-5 (30 September):** zero-turn operation, because only AI turns cost usage ([L389](#l389-only-ai-turns-cost-usage-script-everything-else-and-batch-the-turns)).

Sources: `dominion:main:results/experiments/experiment_map.json` (Sibling fleet operation); the `README.md` of `sib-reg0841`, `sib-tribunal`, `sib-flat1`, `sib-factory`, `sib-contam`, `sib-amx` and `sib-devloop`; RULES.md `#OWNER-STANDING-ORDER-3`, `-4`, `-5`.

### Phase 3. PHerc. Paris 4 title search (25 September - 3 October)

The owner opened this programme on 25 September (DECL-P4-1). The starting position:

- The organizers state the expected title region "has shown no detectable ink so far" and that its top rows are physically missing. Our estimated odds were well under 3 % ([L027](#l027-paris-4-title-search-official-statements-and-odds)).
- The published layout (CErc 54) was extracted by an isolated agent, so the orchestrator stayed blind to the text ([L032](#l032-published-paris-4-layout-cronache-ercolanesi-54-2024), [L364](#l364-grade-research-claims-by-source-strength-and-quarantine-expected-text-material)).
- Priors came from a 70-title dossier ([L282](#l282-where-herculaneum-titles-are-scholarly-priors-for-title-searches)).

**Tried:**

- **Official 2.4 um predictions (26 September).**
  - Readers read 135 of 171 known-text tiles as writing.
  - 39 of 160 target tiles were positive, and 38 of those lay within 1.2 mm of the labelled training segments and were excluded ([L019](#l019-measure-training-label-adjacency-before-spending-reads-on-official-model-output)).
  - The last tile passed phase 2 by one letter over a 4-tile null. It then failed the extended test when 2 of 48 null tiles (rotated known text) reached 7 ([L313](#l313-a-strong-upright-versus-rotated-contrast-shows-orientation-dependence-not-necessarily-writing), [L321](#l321-a-4-tile-null-manufactures-leads-a-rotated-self-null-plus--40-null-tiles-kills-them)).
  - P4-D closed: every core tile is within 1.2 mm of a labelled segment.
- **Model-free raw CT.**
  - The slab-mean censuses found nothing. The thin-slab census found 0 letters on 160 tiles, with a known-text gate of 0/72.
  - Surface-following faces failed the control pre-gate (recall 0.074 / 0.033 against 0.90) ([L204](#l204-model-free-raw-ct-channels-did-not-detect-known-carbon-ink-on-paris-4-at-24-um), [L141](#l141-bright-voxel-thin-slabs-around-the-official-mesh-do-not-show-ink-on-known-text), [L073](#l073-model-free-raw-ct-channels-show-no-column-layout-validate-layout-statistics-on-known-text-of-the-same-strip)).
  - No constant-offset ink layer was found ([L074](#l074-official-meshes-do-not-follow-the-recto-surface-at-a-constant-offset), [L310](#l310-measure-a-calibration-rules-false-pass-rate-on-layer-free-profiles-before-trusting-a-pass)).
- **Pigments.**
  - 0 dense hotspots at 9 offsets across +-60 um. Injection limits: Hg/Pb/Au 0.05-0.1 um, CuO 0.5 um, Fe2O3 0.5-1 um, Egyptian blue 2 um ([L202](#l202-mineral-pigment-high-z-ink-is-ruled-out-on-the-traced-paris-4-surfaces-with-injection-recovery-limits), [L215](#l215-a--60-um-dense-pigment-sweep-closes-mineral-inks-only-at-ct-detectable-thickness)).
  - Iron was insensitive at 5-10 um, and there was no gold on the 2.4 um strip (limit 0.05 um).
  - Dual energy was NULL (0.0001 against a control FPR of 0.0215) and is blind to organic colourants ([L216](#l216-dual-energy-ct-cannot-see-organic-or-lake-colourants-a-null-means-untestable), [L217](#l217-a-null-far-below-the-control-false-positive-rate-signals-a-calibration-transfer-problem)).
  - The copper lane never finished. A safety check blocked the red lane, and the block was not routed around ([L350](#l350-never-work-around-safety-or-permission-blocks)).
- **Cross-scroll checkpoints.** Provenance screens left 0/3, 0/5 and 6/6 (PHerc.1667) eligible ([L175](#l175-check-each-checkpoints-documented-training-data-before-any-inference-eligibility-is-a-documentation-check)). Iteration 5 failed its known-text gate 0/3 at 06:52Z on 27 September, so its target tiles were stopped ([L176](#l176-a-cross-scroll-ink-model-can-be-completely-blind-on-a-new-scroll-gate-it-on-that-scrolls-known-text-first), [L381](#l381-schedule-gate-tiles-before-target-tiles-otherwise-a-failed-gate-throws-away-the-target-tile-compute)).
- **Geometry.**
  - Column 0 of the official strips is the outer end ([L079](#l079-check-grid-orientation-against-geometry-before-counting-column-0-of-the-official-paris-4-strips-is-the-outer-end)). The inner mesh's top edge is a z cut with about 2 mm of sheet above it ([L075](#l075-the-official-paris-4-inner-mesh-top-edge-is-a-z-cut-not-a-sheet-end-little-papyrus-exists-above-it)).
  - There are no mesh holes, and local re-traces failed ([L087](#l087-audit-official-meshes-for-holes-off-sheet-vertices-and-switches-before-blaming-the-render), [L090](#l090-local-re-traces-in-compressed-zones-fail-and-better-metrics-can-come-from-unfilled-holes)).
  - The innermost windings w000-w009 are unsegmented, and the inward count was inconclusive (median 5 at 2.4 um, 4 at 1.129 um) ([L086](#l086-paris-4-official-meshes-start-at-w010-inner-windings-w000-w009-are-unsegmented), [L072](#l072-sheet-crossing-peak-counts-do-not-give-a-reliable-winding-number)).
  - On 30 September the NO-DATA rule followed the finding that missing CT mimics blank tiles ([L015](#l015-missing-ct-chunks-masquerade-as-blank-papyrus)).
- **P4-OWN (27 September - 1 October).**
  - The recipe was hashed before training ([L329](#l329-freeze-and-hash-the-training-recipe-before-the-first-training-step)). The first launch was OOM-killed ([L429](#l429-npconcatenate-over-memory-mapped-shards-silently-loads-everything-into-ram)). Six arm workers were blocked by the permission classifier, so one lane trained all the arms ([L378](#l378-sub-workers-that-must-import-code-from-another-branch-get-blocked-by-the-permission-classifier-commit-shared-code-into-the-recipe-branch-first)).
  - Fold AUCs were about 0.94. G1 passed at 03:42Z on 30 September ([L183](#l183-a-small-cnn-trained-from-scratch-on-the-scrolls-own-labels-detects-its-ink-where-a-cross-scroll-model-failed)).
  - **End-title slot:** 0 of 24 tiles were read as writing in both seeds, against 5/6 and 6/6 for the adjacent known column. Stitched windows also gave 0 candidates ([L219](#l219-state-the-scope-of-every-null-the-own-model-title-slot-null-is-a-carbon-ink-null-only), [L221](#l221-a-brief-that-allows-for-sparse-and-ornamented-writing-plus-a-passing-known-text-gate-makes-a-null-informative-for-that-material)).
  - **Verso offset channel:** pixel-informative (median r 0.120 against a null p95 of 0.039) but reader-insensitive ([L230](#l230-a-statistically-informative-channel-can-still-be-blind-at-reader-level)).
- **Wider own-model searches.** These found text-like column clusters in each successive region; positions withheld ([L232](#l232-do-not-assume-the-first-text-you-confirm-is-the-rolls-first-column)). A candidate was found and tested; details withheld for prize review. A 30 September audit fixed the candidate size rules and the NO-DATA rule before the window census ([L337](#l337-in-text-rich-regions-cap-window-candidates-by-footprint-size)). The audit also noted that all confirmations came from one reader family ([L286](#l286-confirmations-inside-one-block-read-by-one-model-family-are-one-result)).
- **Title Prize material (27 September).** No title identified, the slot null, and a candidate packaged with honest disclosure. Submission needs the owner's sign-in ([L018](#l018-prize-packaging-name-the-official-mesh-licensed-instead-of-redistributing-it-and-build-the-image-in-code), [L474](#l474-google-forms-prize-submission-requires-the-owners-signed-in-account)).

**Learned:**

- A carbon-ink null is not "no title" ([L219](#l219-state-the-scope-of-every-null-the-own-model-title-slot-null-is-a-carbon-ink-null-only)).
- Each display or checkpoint needs its own known-text gate and null ([L323](#l323-treat-each-displaycheckpoint-as-its-own-material-with-its-own-known-text-gate-and-null)).
- Initial titles exist, so search both ends ([L229](#l229-initial-titles-exist-search-both-ends-of-a-roll)).

**Decided:**

- Organic and coloured inks are recorded as untestable with published scans.
- On 26 September the owner switched new readers from "fable" to "opus", which voided the reader calibration ([L279](#l279-changing-the-reader-model-voids-the-reader-calibration)).
- September Progress Prize tools (flatcheck, handcheck, tifxyz-dist) were packaged on 27-30 September. Automated submission was refused, so the owner submitted by hand ([L366](#l366-progress-prizes-are-the-fastest-money-but-require-public-open-source-code-and-the-owners-approval)).

Sources: RULES.md `#DECL-P4-1`, `#P4-C-RESULT`, `#P4-D-RESULT`, `#P4-L4-PREGATE-RESULT`, `#P4-F-SWEEP-RESULT`, `#P4-O-STAGE-O2S1-RESULT`, `#P4-OWN-G1-RESULT`, `#P4-OWN-S1X-RESULT`, `#P4-OWN-S2X-RESULT`, `#P4-OFF-VW-RESULT`, `#DECL-P4-25-A12`; `dominion:sib-own-lead:README.md`; `paris-4:gifted-bell-gavnl5:README.md`; `dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5:logs/owner/AUDIT_2026-09-30.md`.

### Phase 4. First Letters all-out push (30 September - 3 October; 22 eligible scrolls)

**Tried:**

- **Set-up (30 September).** The Paris 4 branches became First Letters workers (DECL-FL-1), with the PHerc0257 pipeline (commit 54b29c96) as the DECL-FL-2 template.
  - No official predictions exist on the eligible volumes ([L029](#l029-no-official-ink-predictions-exist-on-the-first-letters-eligible-volumes)), so most material came from auto-grow ([L036](#l036-many-eligible-scrolls-have-no-organizer-segments-grow-your-own-and-stream-the-surface-prediction)). The seed planner capped each worker at 8 seeds ([L392](#l392-a-deterministic-seed-planner-with-a-fixed-plan-cannot-be-extended-by-re-running-it)).
  - A community dense-model arm was withdrawn 9 minutes after its declaration under the data-use rule ([L387](#l387-reconcile-a-new-model-arm-with-standing-data-use-rules-before-declaring-it)).
  - Detached pipelines were denied by the auto-mode classifier ([L386](#l386-session-permission-layers-refuse-remote-model-code-third-party-downloads-and-detached-launches-plan-approved-paths-up-front)).
- **1 October.**
  - FL-2 wave 1 read 0 of 168 tiles on 21 scrolls as rows. Its gate was not sensitive, so the null was declared uninformative in advance ([L283](#l283-a-0-positive-census-under-a-gate-that-never-passed-is-uninformative)).
  - The FL-3 stitched-window gate reached 3 of 16 rows and a maximum count of 4 against an unchanged bar of 5. Its census of 656 windows was null ([L290](#l290-stitched-windows-raised-reader-sensitivity-but-did-not-reach-legibility-on-held-out-text)).
  - That morning, lane checks had already flagged grown meshes with no support on the sheet (median on-sheet fraction 0.1955). The tiles were read anyway ([L391](#l391-lane-level-numeric-checks-caught-the-grow-failure-a-day-before-the-central-verdict)).
  - At about 17:19Z (DECL-FL-4-A1) the owner moved the fleet to the inner windings of PHerc0268 and PHerc0490A with the Grand Prize TimeSformer, and dropped its PHerc0139 gate ([L212](#l212-dropping-the-positive-control-to-save-time-left-every-later-read-of-this-arm-without-meaning), [L188](#l188-run-the-grand-prize-timesformer-through-the-organizers-code-and-scale-match-the-voxel-size)).
- **2 October.**
  - At 07:58-08:01Z every keepalive overran the 7,200 s limit, and the fleet stopped ([L442](#l442-a-keepalive-must-end-inside-the-7200-s-background-limit-the-harness-forbids-restarting-a-max-timeout-command)).
  - DECL-FL-4-A5: the grower had run without normal grids, and every grow was the same 11.667 cm2 square. The 43 FL-4 reads were void.
  - DECL-FL-5 extended this to all 2,596 FL-2/FL-3 tiles ([L100](#l100-grows-without-normal-grids-are-data-independent-know-the-failure-signatures)).
- **Normal-grid grows (2-3 October).**
  - Median |cos| was 0.93, and 2 of 8 patches passed. The owner's cross-section then showed a passing patch jumping layers at cracks ([L101](#l101-numeric-surface-gates-are-blind-to-layer-jumps-on-crushed-scrolls-look-at-cross-sections)).
  - GP marked 46-59 % of each patch as ink, and the maps were voided ([L291](#l291-blind-reader-output-was-suspended-in-favour-of-ownerorchestrator-triage-on-fl-4)).
  - The row-structure score flagged 1.8 % of known text against 25 % ([L233](#l233-an-automated-row-structure-score-did-not-detect-known-text-on-9-um-maps)).
  - Organizer segments of PHerc0800 (6) and PHerc1203 (20) gave 0 candidates ([L189](#l189-public-ink-models-produce-no-text-like-structure-on-organizer-sheets-of-pherc0800-and-pherc1203-a-null-is-not-blank-papyrus), [L235](#l235-two-model-agreement-with-rotation-controls-is-a-cheap-ink-feature-check)).
- **3 October.** FL6-RESULT: no candidate exists, nothing is submittable, and no letter was ever claimed. The public tools xsec, ringstrip and orgsec-ink were released.

**Learned:**

- A null counts only with an in-batch positive control that passes in the same session ([L218](#l218-a-null-counts-only-when-an-in-batch-positive-control-on-comparable-never-trained-text-passes-in-the-same-session)).
- Identical grows are a red flag ([L100](#l100-grows-without-normal-grids-are-data-independent-know-the-failure-signatures)).
- Publishing the failure modes is the durable output ([L198](#l198-publishing-the-failure-modes-the-radial-gate-blind-spot-row-score-insensitivity-is-the-durable-output-of-a-null-push)).

**4-8 October:** the research log has no commits.

Sources: RULES.md `#DECL-FL-2-E1`, `#FL3-W1-RESULT`, `#DECL-FL-4-A1`, `#DECL-FL-4-A5`, `(DECL-FL-5)`, `#DECL-FL-4-A8`, `#FL5-ROWSCORE-RESULT`, `#FL6-RESULT`; `dominion:fl4t:README.md`; `xsec:HEAD:README.md`.

### Phase 5. PHerc0268 at native resolution (9-10 October)

**Tried:**

- **Fleet.** A second fleet of 52 sessions started. Idle containers turned out to be reclaimed after each turn, killing detached jobs ([L444](#l444-idle-sibling-containers-are-reclaimed-and-detached-jobs-die-with-them), [L443](#l443-session-count-is-not-compute)).
- **Frame.** One lane read the roll axis as y. The spiral lane showed it is z, with the roll telescoped ([L038](#l038-pherc0268s-roll-axis-is-volume-z-not-y-axial-telescoping-fools-a-quick-look)).
- **Umbilicus.**
  - At survey scale (69 um) a stable core appeared in 1 of 86 sections against a 50 % bar.
  - The owner ruled that claims are made only at native 8.64 um and that the scroll is rolled, not folded. The fold reading was withdrawn ([L104](#l104-never-make-sheet-level-claims-below-the-scans-native-resolution), [L107](#l107-point-concurrency-umbilicus-fits-fail-on-flattened-stacks-a-crushed-scroll-may-have-no-single-axis)).
  - The native operator (DECL-UMB-2) failed its phantom precondition (0/48), and its edge columns disagreed by 14-43 mm. The umbilicus is NOT DETERMINED ([L102](#l102-run-the-phantom-precondition-before-reading-real-output), [L103](#l103-phantoms-must-match-the-measured-geometry-especially-lamina-spacing)).
- **E2E-1.** One 19 mm strip came out. Coverage was 0.053, seam consistency 0.23, and centring 0.61 against 0.90 ([L053](#l053-the-stitching-works-mechanically-but-a-strip-is-only-as-good-as-the-surfaces-under-it)).
- **Master ink model.** Federated CPU training reached held-out AUC 0.5793 / 0.5778 against 0.90, although the lanes reported 0.63-0.68 on their own validation ([L190](#l190-validation-on-the-training-scroll-overstated-transfer), [L192](#l192-cpu-trained-from-scratch-ink-models-at-864-um-stalled-far-below-a-public-baseline)). A dense-model fine-tune gave no gain ([L191](#l191-fine-tuning-on-pseudo-labels-produced-by-another-model-can-pull-a-stronger-model-toward-the-labellers-errors)). Reference AUCs: dense 0.7605, Hecate 0.7309, 8 um model 0.7499, ink_9um 0.6539.
- **ORD-3.** Sheet identity was lost within about 0.3 mm. The 216-window survey found the scroll homogeneous, and the VC3D surface audit had no power ([L110](#l110-a-selection-statistic-must-fail-where-tracking-is-known-to-fail), [L115](#l115-local-sheet-identity-tracking-at-864-um-fails-across-the-whole-of-pherc0268)).
- **Usage.** At about 05:15Z on 10 October every sibling stopped with "out of usage credits" (a seven-day limit) ([L371](#l371-plan-for-account-session-caps-and-usage-limits-when-delegating)).

**Learned:** The binding constraint was availability, not method ([L412](#l412-on-a-usage-capped-cpu-only-ephemeral-platform-the-binding-constraint-was-availability-not-method)). Phantoms must match the measured geometry ([L103](#l103-phantoms-must-match-the-measured-geometry-especially-lamina-spacing)).

**Decided:** The local-operator line was closed, and the next step was to test the organizers' spiral fit.

Sources: RULES.md `#UMB-PHERC0268-RESULT`, `-A1`, `#UMB2-B6-RESULT`, `#E2E-1-RESULT`, `#FL7-A1-RESULT`, `#ORD3-PILOTB-RESULT`, `#ORD3-S3-RESULT`, `#SIB-KEEPALIVE-1`.

### Phase 6. PHerc0268 spiral fitting (10-11 October; pherc0268 repository)

**Tried:**

- **Proof of concept.** An outside-in test on the air-papyrus boundary was committed, then removed in a clean slate with three gates: sheet patches, gold ink and a stitched sheet ([L119](#l119-an-outer-air-papyrus-boundary-surface-at-the-scroll-end-is-not-a-reading-surface)).
- **Plan.** Run the PHerc0343 recipe (villa 0fb38c45) CPU-only with a sibling swarm ([L043](#l043-two-incompatible-spiral-fitting-methods-exist-the-one-that-read-pherc0343-is-the-pinned-0fb38c45-version)).
- **Pathfinder units.**
  - U2 found axis z, an 82-point umbilicus, and sense CW from the catalog only ([L040](#l040-outward-sense-cw-comes-from-catalog-flags-only-catalog-values-can-be-wrong-and-a-wrong-sense-cannot-be-fitted-away)).
  - U3's band tracks were identical to the full DBM ([L041](#l041-extract-one-z-band-of-the-25-gb-published-tracks-with-http-range-reads-instead-of-downloading-everything)), and U4's SDT was voxel-exact.
  - A six-reader study was adversarially verified ([L395](#l395-adversarial-verification-of-study-reports-catches-confident-errors)).
- **CPU fits.**
  - Order 2: the first fit was OOM at load, grew +0.25 GiB per step and ran about 29 s/step.
  - Order 6 (00:20Z, 11 October, the owner's decision) said to fit now, CPU only. One `gc.collect()` per step held memory flat ([L447](#l447-cpu-spiral-fit-memory-growth-is-reference-cycles-one-gccollect-per-step-holds-rss-flat)).
  - 68 windows ran on about 42 sandboxes; 33 quarter units never got one ([L397](#l397-cloud-sandboxes-cap-at-42-concurrent-plan-swarms-in-waves-with-a-claim-queue)).
  - A `*.tif` gitignore rule had dropped every mesh ([L399](#l399-gitignore-tif-silently-dropped-every-tifxyz-mesh-from-unit-pushes)). Speed patch 0005 was 40 % slower end to end ([L396](#l396-kernel-only-benchmarks-under-contention-mislead-measure-end-to-end-on-the-same-window)).
- **Diagnosis.**
  - The 2,000-step fits never switched on track_dt, and turning it on moved the lock by only +0.03 ([L121](#l121-villas-spiral-fit-defaults-assume-30000-steps-a-2000-step-horizon-never-switches-on-trackdt)).
  - The 2.46 phase-lock "bar" came from a post-snap-and-flatten mesh ([L120](#l120-compare-a-number-only-with-a-bar-from-the-same-pipeline-stage)).
  - The real failure was orientation: 42 deg against 6 deg ([L124](#l124-the-fit-failure-signature-is-orientation-not-phase-median-normal-angle-42-deg-vs-6-deg-for-the-recipe)).
  - A foreign-scroll segment in the VC3D pool voided that calibration ([L048](#l048-audit-calibration-and-validation-sets-for-scroll-identity)).
- **First Letters phase 1.** The protocol was declared first ([L344](#l344-declare-the-candidate-rule-and-mandatory-false-positive-controls-before-any-search-data)). The 103-surface pool held no winnable surface ([L128](#l128-no-winnable-surface-existed-in-a-103-surface-pherc0268-pool)). The 3-D tracer drifted, with 46 % of nodes more than one sheet off ([L122](#l122-a-3-d-tracer-without-an-in-loop-orientation-gate-drifts-off-the-sheet)), and there was no coherent ink on validated surfaces ([L193](#l193-public-villa-ink-models-give-no-coherent-signal-on-verifiable-pherc0268-surfaces)).
- **Order 9 (11 October).** A one-command detached autopilot ran 10,000-step fits with no AI polling ([L362](#l362-keep-long-jobs-detached-and-self-pushing-in-turn-polling-burns-the-accounts-usage)). No evaluation of those fits is recorded.

**Learned:**

- Copy the full schedule ([L121](#l121-villas-spiral-fit-defaults-assume-30000-steps-a-2000-step-horizon-never-switches-on-trackdt)) and compare at the same stage ([L120](#l120-compare-a-number-only-with-a-bar-from-the-same-pipeline-stage)).
- A CPU port is a research port until it reproduces a known result ([L401](#l401-a-cpu-port-is-a-research-port-until-it-reproduces-a-known-result)).

Sources: `pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:docs/SPIRAL_PLAN.md`, `SPIRAL_STUDY.md`, `BANDS.md`, `QUEUE.md`, `POC.md`, `FL_SEARCH.md`, `units/U2-umbilicus.md`.

### Phase 7. Mass ink run and the blank-margin bug (14 October)

**Tried:**

- **Mass run.** 65 patches were screened and 56 inked (about 37 cm2). The first-pass "ink" appeared as bands inside the strip edges.
- **DECL-FL-STRIP** (pre-registered, PHerc0343 letters). 13-row strips do not see ink (recall 0.386 [0.257, 0.493]), and 2 real padding rows do not fix it (0.517) ([L161](#l161-padding-thin-strips-with-extra-real-rows-does-not-restore-ink-recall), [L163](#l163-know-the-renderers-blank-margin-before-cutting-strips)).
- **DECL-FL-FILL.** The reflect fill restored the control (0.646) but doubled off-letter strong pixels ([L162](#l162-margin-fill-restores-sensitivity-but-raises-off-letter-strong-pixels-measure-its-no-ink-floor)). On 7 PHerc0268 strips, strong ink fell 2.96-623.9x and the bands disappeared in 5. The first-pass ink was the artifact ([L249](#l249-the-blank-margin-bug-partly-blank-inference-patches-create-or-suppress-ink), [L252](#l252-where-the-villa-defect-lives-robust-normalisation-over-blank-voxels)).
- **Code and rerun.** The villa main 5432721 normalisation code is byte-identical to 41701aa ([L252](#l252-where-the-villa-defect-lives-robust-normalisation-over-blank-voxels)). A fresh-input rerun matched 22/22 values, which is deterministic, not independent ([L507](#l507-a-deterministic-rerun-is-not-an-independent-reproduction)).
- **Blind reads.**
  - Read #1, uncalibrated, missed the hidden positives.
  - Read #2 reached reader AUC 0.875-0.900 against a colour-only baseline of 0.975 ([L293](#l293-an-uncalibrated-blind-read-is-uninformative-hide-known-letters-and-no-ink-strips-among-the-targets), [L294](#l294-report-nothing-from-reads-whose-calibration-failed), [L295](#l295-readers-are-ai-agents-say-so-and-keep-coarse-roc-caveats)).
  - A candidate was found and tested; details withheld for prize review. Its DECL-FL-CAND physical tests were declared before data ([L296](#l296-forms-flagged-by-every-reader-can-sit-on-known-artifact-zones-test-them-physically-before-any-claim)).

**Decided:**

- No letters claimed.
- Superseded claims were listed the same day ([L349](#l349-list-superseded-claims-explicitly-the-same-day)).
- The 56 patches were queued for re-ink. No results are recorded.

Sources: `dominion:main:docs/RESULTS.md`, `docs/METHODS.md#4`; `pherc0268:gifted-bell-gavnl5:poc/ctrl343_strips/DECL.md`, `poc/mass_fill/DECL.md`, `docs/FL_SEARCH.md`.

### Phase 8. Release (14-15 October)

**Done:**

- A read-only survey wrote a README for every experiment branch under the confidentiality rules.
- Eleven adversarial review passes corrected the experiment map from 182 experiments (130 published, 52 withheld) to 175: 103 published, and 72 withheld (every Paris 4 experiment).
- The owner approved publishing and overrode the third-party-model rule for the release's positive control only. 119 branch READMEs were pushed.
- `dominion:main` holds `stripqc`, 33 lessons and the retracted claims. This file supersedes those lessons.

Sources: RULES.md `#OWNER-ORDER-RELEASE-I10`, `-I10-A1`; `dominion:main:README.md`, `docs/EXPERIMENTS.md`.

## Part 7. Experiment register

Every canon experiment (309 rows), grouped by scroll or family; rows within a group are sorted by start date. Columns:
- **experiment**: register ID, title and aliases (aliases are the RULES.md section or lane names used in the sources).
- **dates**: UTC dates as recorded; "(family period)" means the dates of the family, not of the single run.
- **verdict**: PASSED (met its declared bar), FAILED (missed it), PARTIAL (some arms or bars met), NULL (ran correctly, found nothing), VOID (invalid run or uninformative by its own rules), OPEN (not finished when the programme stopped), WITHHELD (prize hold-out). The text after the verdict is the recorded result.
- **key numbers**: numbers from the sources that are not already in the result text; a bracket names the source file or RULES.md section.
- **lesson**: the lesson the experiment taught; "Related" points to the numbered lessons in Parts 1-3 that cover the same point (matched by content, so read them as cross-references, not as the only source).
- **branch**: where the code and results live. `dominion:<lane>` is branch `claude/gifted-bell-gavnl5-<lane>`; `dominion:gifted-bell-gavnl5` is the research log; `dominion:main` is the October 2026 release; `pherc0268:` is the PHerc0268 repository. Each lane branch has a README.md with its own quick start.

Rows marked WITHHELD concern First Letters or First Title prize candidates: a candidate was found and tested; details withheld for prize review. No letters are claimed on any scroll.

### PHerc0139 and PHerc0841: base chain, reader calibration and the D1-D4 gates

27 experiments: 8 PASSED, 6 FAILED, 7 PARTIAL, 4 VOID, 2 OPEN.

An internal review on 30 September estimated that 43 % of project time went to usage limits, and ~25-40 h to container reclaims, refusals and serial CPU work. These are estimates, not measurements. Recorded failure classes: - repeated account usage-limit stops of readers, auditors and siblings; - at least seven container restarts, which wiped RAM-disk scratch; - agent safety-check refusals of form submission, file deletion, a data-branch push, recurring check-ins, session creation and cross-branch code, none of which was routed around; - a 7,200 s limit on background commands; - a near-full disk; - a final seven-day credit exhaustion.
